file: A Safe Stronghold Our God is Still (Martin Luther).xml
title: A Safe Stronghold Our God is Still

verses.name: v1
v2
verses.text:
With force of arms we nothing can,
Full soon were we down-ridden;
But for us fights the proper Man,
Whom God Himself hath bidden.
Ask ye: Who is this same?
Christ Jesus is His name,
The Lord Sabaoth’s Son;
He, and no other one,
Shall conquer in the battle.

verses.name: v3
v4
verses.text:
God’s word, for all their craft and force,
One moment will not linger,
But, spite of hell, shall have its course;
’Tis written by His finger.
And though they take our life,
Goods, honour, children, wife,
Yet is their profit small:
These things shall vanish all;
The city of God remaineth.

file: All People That on Earth Do Dwell (William Kethe).xml
title: All People That on Earth Do Dwell

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
All people that on earth do dwell,
Sing to the Lord with cheerful voice;
Him serve with mirth, His praise forthtell,
Come ye before Him and rejoice.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Know that the Lord is God indeed,
Without our aid He did us make:
We are His flock, He doth us feed,
And for His sheep He doth us take.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
O enter then His gates with praise,
Approach with joy His courts unto:
Praise, laud, and bless His name always,
For it is seemly so to do.

verses.name: v4
v5
verses.text:
Praise God from whom all blessings flow,
Praise Him all creatures here below,
Praise Him above, ye heavenly hosts;
Praise Father, Son and Holy Ghost.

file: All Things Bright and Beautiful (Cecil F. Alexander).xml
title: All Things Bright and Beautiful

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
All things bright and beautiful,
All creatures great and small,
All things wise and wonderful,
The Lord God made them all.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Each little flower that opens,
Each little bird that sings,
He made their glowing colours,
He made their tiny wings.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
The purple-headed mountain,
The river running by,
The sunset, and the morning
That brightens up the sky.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
The cold wind in the winter,
The pleasant summer sun,
The ripe fruits in the garden,
He made them every one.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
He gave us eyes to see them,
And lips that we might tell
How great is God Almighty,
Who has made all things well.

file: All for Jesus (J. Stainer).xml
title: All for Jesus

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
All for Jesus-- all for Jesus,
This our song shall ever be;
For we have no hope, nor Saviour,
If we have not hope in Thee.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
All for Jesus-- Thou will give us
Strength to serve Thee, hour by hour;
None can move us from Thy presence,
While we trust Thy love and power.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
All for Jesus-- at Thine altar
Thou wilt give us sweet content
There, dear Lord, we shall receive Thee
In the solemn Sacrament.

verses.name: v4
v5
verses.text:
All for Jesus-- all for Jesus
This the Church's song must be;
Till, at last, her sons are gathered
One in love and one in Thee.

file: All the Way My Saviour Leads Me (Fanny Crosby).xml
title: All the Way My Saviour Leads Me

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
All the way my saviour leads me,
What have I to ask beside?
Can I doubt His tender mercy,
Who through life has been my guide?
Heavenly peace, divinest comfort,
Here by faith in Him to dwell,
For I know whate’er befall me,
Jesus doeth all things well.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
All the way my Saviour leads me,
Cheers each winding path I tread.
Gives me grace for every trial,
Feeds me with the Living Bread.
Though my weary steps may falter
And my soul athirst may be,
Gushing from a Rock before me,
Lo! a spring of joy I see.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
And all the way my Saviour leads me,
Oh, the fullness of His love.
Perfect rest to me is promised
In my Father’s house above.
And when my spirit clothed immortal
Wings its flight to realms of day,
This my song through endless ages,
Jesus led me all the way.

file: Ang Aking Pag-asa_y Lubos (Edward Mote).xml
title: Ang Aking Pag-asa'y Lubos

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Ang aking pag-asa’y lubos
Na nakasalig kay Hesus
At ang dugo N’yang dumanak
Sa aking sala’y panghugas

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
Chorus
Si kristo ang sandigan ko 
S’ya ang matibay kong bato
Kanlungan ko pag may bagyo.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Kahit danasin ko’y hirap
Biyaya N’ya’y laging sapat
At pag ako’y nanlulumo
Lakas ko’y kanyang pangako.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Pag trumpeta’y hihipan na
At pagdating N’ya ang badya
Tayo nawa’y masumpungang
Taglay kanyang kabanalan.

file: Ang Biyaya ng Diyos (Tagalog Hymn).xml
title: Ang Biyaya ng Diyos

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Ang biyaya ng Panginoon,
B'yayang higit kaysa 'ting sala;
Sa Kalbaryo doon nabuhos
Ang dugo ng Kordero ng Dios.

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
O biyayang nagoaoatawad sa 'ting   sala
O biyayang higit sa lahat nating sala

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Sala at hirap parang alon
Kaluluwa'y halos malunod
Biyaya N'yang hindi matalos
Nakaturo sa kanlungang krus.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Dungis ng sala'y 'di maitago
Ano kayang makakahugas?
Masda't umaagos ang dugo
Magtiwala ka't maliligtas.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Biyaya na walang kapantay
Sadyang bigay sa magtiwala
O kung ibig mo S'yang makita
Tanggapin mong Kanyang biyaya.

file: Ang Nagpapahayag ng Tungkol Kay Kristo (Tagalog Hymn).xml
title: Ang Nagpapahayag ng Tungkol Kay Kristo

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Ang Nagpapahayag ng Tungkol kay Kristo
Ay may gantimpala na matatamo
Sa mundong ibabaw uusigin tayo
S'ya'y sumasaatin; hwag manlulumo

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
Ating kakamtan, Ating kakamtan
Ang saganang bunga ng pagpapagal
O anong tuwa! O anong saya!
Ang lubusan nating madadarama

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Hwag manghihinawang maglingkod kay Kristo
Iwaksi ang takot at pangamba mo
Balitaan natin ang lahat ng tao
At ang gantimpala Nya'y matatamo

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Sa ginhawa't hirap ating ipangaral
Kaligtasang dulot ng Dios na banal
Ang hirap at pagod ay malilimutan
Pag si Kristo'y atin nang napagmasdan

file: Angel Voices Ever Singing (Francis Pott).xml
title: Angel Voices Ever Singing

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Angel voices ever singing
Round Thy throne of light,
Angel harps forever ringing,
Rest not day nor night;

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Thousands only live to bless Thee,
And confess Thee
Lord of might.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Thou who art beyond the farthest
Mortal eye can scan,
Can it be that Thou regardest
Songs of sinful man?

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Can we know that Thou art near us
And wilt hear us?
Yes, we can.

verses.name: v5
v6
verses.text:
Craftsman’s art and music’s measure
For Thy pleasure
All combine.

verses.name: v7
verses.text:
In Thy house, great God, we offer
Of Thine own to Thee,
And for Thine acceptance proffer,
All unworthily,

verses.name: v8
verses.text:
Hearts and minds and hands and voices
In our choicest
Psalmody.

verses.name: v9
verses.text:
Honour, glory, might, and merit
Thine shall ever be,
Father, Son, and Holy Spirit,
Blessed Trinity.

verses.name: v10
verses.text:
Of the best that Thou hast given
Earth and heaven
Render Thee.

file: Angels From the Realms of Glory (James Montgomery).xml
title: Angels From the Realms of Glory

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Angels, from the realms of Glory,
Wing your flight o’er all the earth;
Ye who sang creation’s story,
Now proclaim Messiah’s birth:

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
Come and worship
Christ, the new-born King.
Come and worship
Worship Christ, the new-born King.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Shepherds, in the field abiding,
Watching o’er your flocks by night,
God with man is now residing,
Yonder shines the infant-light:

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Sages, leave your contemplations,
Brighter visions beam afar;
Seek the great desire of nations,
Ye have seen His natal star:

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Saints, before the altar bending,
Watching long in hope and fear,
Suddenly the Lord descending
In His temple shall appear:

file: As With Gladness (W. C. Dix).xml
title: As With Gladness

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
As with gladness men of old
Did the guiding star behold;
As with joy they hailed its light,
Leading onward, beaming bright,
So, most gracious God, may we
Evermore be led by Thee.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
As with joyful steps they sped,
Saviour, to Thy lowly bed,
There to bend the knee before
Thee whom heaven and earth adore,
So may we with willing feet
Ever seek Thy mercy-seat.
As they offered gifts most rare
At Thy cradle rude and bare,
So may we with holy joy,
Pure, and free from sin’s alloy,
All our costliest treasures bring,
Christ, to Thee, our heavenly King.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Holy Jesus, every day
Keep us in the narrow way;
And, when earthly things are past,
Bring our ransomed souls at last
Where they need no star to guide,
Where no clouds Thy glory hide.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
In the heavenly country bright
Need they no created light;
Thou its light, its joy, its crown,
Thou its sun, which goes not down.
There forever may we sing
Hallelujahs to our King.

file: At the Name of Jesus (Caroline Maria Noel).xml
title: At the Name of Jesus

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
At the name of Jesus,
Every knee shall bow,
Every tongue confess Him
King of glory now;
’Tis the Father’s pleasure
We should call Him Lord,
Who from the beginning
Was the mighty Word.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Humbled for a season,
To receive a name
From the lips of sinners
Unto whom He came;
Faithfully He bore it
Spotless to the last,
Brought it back victorious,
When from death He passed.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Bore it up triumphant
With its human light,
Through all ranks of creatures
To the central height,
To the throne of Godhead,
To the Father’s breast,
Filled it with the glory
Of that perfect rest.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
In your hearts enthrone Him;
There let Him subdue
All that is not holy,
All that is not true;
Crown Him as your Captain
In temptation’s hour,
Let His will enfold you
In its light and power.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
Brothers, this Lord Jesus
Shall return again,
With His Father’s glory,
With His angel-train;
For all wreaths of empire
Meet upon His brow,
And our hearts confess Him
King of glory now.

file: BUHAY KO’Y _YONG KUNIN (Tagalog Hymn).xml
title: BUHAY KO’Y 'YONG KUNIN

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Buhay Ko ay ‘Yong kunin
Panginoon, gamitin
Mga araw’t sandali
Puspusin ng papuri.
Puspusin ng papuri.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Kamay ko’y pakilusin
Sa pag-ibig himukin
Paa ko ay gamitin
Sa banal Mong gawain
Sa banal Mong gawain

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Tinig ko ay kunin Mo
Laging aawitan ka
Gamitin ang bibig ko
Ituro ‘Yong salita.
Ituro ‘Yong salita.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Lahat kong kayamanan
Sa’yo na, Panginoon
Taglay kong kaalaman
Sa gawai’y ilaan.
Sa gawai’y ilaan.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
Kalooba’y supilin
Sa layon Mo hubugin
Puso ko ay tahanan
Pagharian kaylanman.
Pagharian kaylanman.

verses.name: v6
verses.text:
Kunin Mo’ng pag-ibig ko
Sa’Yo’y iniaalay
Buo kong pagkatao
Sa’yo na habangbuhay
Sa’yo na habangbuhay

file: Be Known to us in Breaking Bread (James Montgomery).xml
title: Be Known to us in Breaking Bread

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Be known to is breaking bread,
But do not then depart;
Saviour, abide with us, and spread
Thy table in our heart.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
There sup with us in love divine;
Thy body and Thy blood,
That living bread, that heavenly wine,
Be our immortal food.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
We would not live by bread alone,
But by Thy word of grace,
In strength of which we travel on
To our abiding place.

file: Be Still and Know (Author Unknown).xml
title: Be Still and Know

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Be still and know that I am God,
Be still and know that I am God,
Be still and know that I am God.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
I am the Lord that healeth thee,
I am the Lord that healeth thee,
I am the Lord that healeth thee.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
In Thee, O Lord, do I put my trust,
In Thee, O Lord, do I put my trust,
In Thee, O Lord, do I put my trust.

file: Before the Throne of God Above (Charitie L. Bancroft).xml
title: Before the Throne of God Above

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Before the throne of God above,
I have a strong, a perfect plea,
A great High Priest whose name is Love,
Who ever lives and pleads for me.
My name is graven on His hands,
My name is written on His heart;
I know that while in heaven He stands 
No tongue can bid me thence depart,
No tongue can bid me thence depart.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
When Satan tempts me to despair,
And tells me of the guilt within,
Upward I look and see Him there 
Who made an end to all my sin.
Because the sinless Saviour died,
My sinful soul is counted free;
For God the Just is satisfied
To look on Him and pardon me,
To look on Him and pardon me.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Behold Him there! The risen Lamb,
My perfect, spotless righteousness;
The great unchangeable I AM,
The King of glory and of grace!
One with Himself I cannot die,
My soul is purchased with His blood;
My life is hid with Christ on high,
With Christ, my Saviour and my God,
With Christ my Saviour and my God.

file: Behold the Servant of the Lord (Charles Wesley).xml
title: Behold the Servant of the Lord

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Behold the servant of the Lord:
I wait Thy guiding eye to feel,
To hear and keep Thy every word,
To prove and do Thy perfect will;
Joyful from my own works to cease,
Glad to fulfil all righteousness.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Me if Thy grace vouchsafe to use,
Meanest of all Thy creatures, me.
The deed, the time, the manner choose:
Let all my fruit be found of Thee.
Let all my works in Thee be wrought,
By Thee to full perfection brought.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
My every weak though good design
O’errule or change, as seems Thee meet:
Jesus, let all my work be Thine –
Thy work, O Lord, is all complete,
And pleasing in Thy Father’s sight;
Thou only hast done all things right.

verses.name: v4

file: Beneath the Cross (Elizabeth C. Clephane).xml
title: Beneath the Cross

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Beneanth the cross of Jesus
I fain would take my stand,
The shadow of a mighty rock
Within a weary land;
A home within the wilderness,
A rest upon the way,
From the burning of the noontide heat,
And the burden of the day.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
O safe and happy shelter!
O refuge tried and sweet!
O trysting place where heaven’s love
And heaven’s justice meet!
As to the holy patriarch
That wondrous dream was given,
So seems my Saviour’s cross to me
A ladder up to heaven.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
There lies, beneath its shadow,
But on the farther side,
The darkness of an awful grave
That gapes both deep and wide;
And there between us stands the cross,
Two arms outstretched to save;
Like a watchman set to guard the way
From that eternal grave.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Upon that cross of Jesus
Mine eye at times can see
The very dying form of One
Who suffered there for me;
And from my smitten heart, with tears,
Two wonders I confess—
The wonders of His glorious love,
And my own worthlessness.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
I take, O cross, thy shadow,
For my abiding place;
I ask no other sunshine than
The sunshine of His face;
Content to let the world go by,
To know no gain nor loss—
My sinful self my only shame,
My glory all the cross.

file: Biyaya ng Dios ang Tumubos (Tagalog Hymn).xml
title: Biyaya ng Dios ang Tumubos

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Biyaya ng Dios ang tumubos,
Sa akin ay kumupkop;
Hinanap N'ya akong sa sala'y naligaw.
Iniligtas na tunay.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Dahil sa biyaya N'yang banal
Takot ko ay naparam;
Anong laking galak ang sumapuso ko
Nang pasakop kay Kristo.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Biyaya ang sa 'kiy nagligtas
Sa panganib at hirap;
Biyaya din ng Dios ang s'yang maghahatid
Sa 'kin doon sa langit.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Kung tayo ay nasa langit na
At Dios ay sinasamba,
Biyaya N'yang wagas ating isasaysay
Doon magpakaylan man.

file: Bless the Lord, O My Soul (Author Unknown).xml
title: Bless the Lord, O My Soul

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Bless the Lord, O my soul,
Bless the Lord, O my soul,
And all that is within me
Bless His holy name.
Bless the Lord, O my soul,
Bless the Lord, O my soul,
And all that is within me
Bless His holy name.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
King of kings, (for ever and ever,)
Lord of lords, (for ever and ever,)
King of kings, (for ever and ever,)
King of kings and Lord of lords.

file: Blessed Be The Name (W.H. CLARK).xml
title: Blessed Be The Name

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
All praise to Him who reigns above
In majesty supreme,
Who gave His son for man to die,
That He might man redeem!

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
Blessed be the name, blessed be the name,
Blessed be the name of the Lord!
Blessed be the name, blessed be the name,
Blessed be the name of the Lord!

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
His name above all names shall stand,
Exalted more and more,
At God the Father's own right hand,
Where angel hosts adore.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Redeemer Savior, Friend of man
Once ruined by the fall,
Thou hast devised salvation plan, 
For thou hast died for all.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
His name shall be the Counselor,
The mighty Prince of Peace,
Of all eath's kingdoms Conqueror,
Whose reign shall never cease.

file: Break Thou the Bread of Life (Mary A. Lathbury, Alexander Groves).xml
title: Break Thou the Bread of Life

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Break thou the bread of Life,
Dear Lord, to me,
As Thou didst break the bread
Beside the sea;

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Beyond the sacred page
I seek Thee, Lord;
My spirit longs for Thee,
Thou Living Word.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Thou art the Bread of Life,
O Lord, to me,
Thy holy Word the truth
That saveth me;

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Give me to eat and live
With Thee above;
Teach me to love Thy truth,
For Thou art love.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
O send Thy Spirit, Lord,
Now unto me,
That He may touch my eyes
And make me see;

verses.name: v6
verses.text:
Show me the truth concealed
Within Thy Word,
And in Thy Book revealed,
I see Thee, Lord.

verses.name: v7
verses.text:
Bless Thou the Bread of Life
To me, to me,
As Thou didst bless the loaves
By Galilee;

verses.name: v8
verses.text:
Then shall all bondage cease,
All fetters fall,
And I shall find my peace,
My all in all.

file: Breathe On Me, Breath of God (Edwin Hatch).xml
title: Breathe On Me, Breath of God

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Breathe on me, Breath of God,
Fill me with life anew;
That I may love what Thou dost love
And do what Thou wouldst do.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Breathe on me, Breath of God,
Until my heart is pure;
Until my will is one with Thine
To do and to endure.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Breathe on me, Breath of God,
Till I am wholly Thine;
Until this earthly part of me
Glows with Thy fire divine.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Breathe on me, Breath of God,
So shall I never die,
But live with Thee the perfect life
Of Thine eternity.

file: Buhay ang Kristong Aking Pinaglilingkuran (Tagalog Hymn).xml
title: Buhay ang Kristong Aking Pinaglilingkuran

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Buhay ang Kristong aking pinaglilingkuran
Kahit anong sabihin ng sangkatauhan;
Ang tinig N'yang maamo't mapagpalang kamay
Sa tuwina'y malapit at kapisan!

verses.name: c1
v2
verses.text:
Pagdamay nakikita sa lahat ng dako,
At kahit napapagod may tuwa ang puso;
S'ya ang aking patnubay sa mabagyong mundo,
At S'ya'y magpapakitang muli dito.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Magdiwang, O Kristiano, tinig mo'y itaas,
At purihin si Kristo na Hari ng lahat!
S'ya ang tanging pag-asa ng nagsisihanap,
Wala na ngang iba pang kasinliyag!

file: Christ, Whose Glory Fills the Skies (Charles Wesley).xml
title: Christ, Whose Glory Fills the Skies

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Christ, whose glory fills the skies,
Christ, the true, the only light,
Sun of righteousness, arise,
Triumph o'er the shades of night:
Day-spring from on high, be near;
Day-star in my heart appear.

verses.name: v2
v3

file: Christians Awake (J. Byrom).xml
title: Christians Awake

verses.name: v1
v2
verses.text:
Then to the watchful shepherds it was told,
Who heard the angelic herald’s voice ‘Behold,
I bring good tidings of a Saviour’s birth
To you and all the nations upon earth:
This day hath God fulfilled His promised word,
This day is born a Saviour, Christ the Lord.’

verses.name: v3
v4
v5
verses.text:
Then may we hope, the angelic hosts among,
To sing, redeemed, a glad triumphant song:
He that was born upon this joyful day
Around us all His glory shall display;
Saved by His love, incessant we shall sing
Eternal praise to heaven’s almighty King.

file: Come Bless the Lord (Author Unknown).xml
title: Come Bless the Lord

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Come bless the Lord,
All ye servants of the Lord,
Who stand by night in the house of the Lord.
Lift up your hands in the holy place,
Come bless the Lord, 
Come bless the Lord.

file: Come Let Us Join Our Cheerful Songs (Isaac Watts).xml
title: Come Let Us Join Our Cheerful Songs

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Come, let us join our cheerful songs,
With angels round the throne;
Ten thousand thousand are their tongues,
But all their joys are one.
‘Worthy the Lamb that died,’ they cry,
‘To be exalted thus.’
‘Worthy the Lamb,’ our lips reply,
‘For He was slain for us.’

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Jesus is worthy to receive
Honour and power divine:
And blessings, more than we can give,
Be, Lord, forever Thine.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Let all that dwell above the sky,
And air, and earth, and seas,
Conspire to lift Thy glories high,
And speak Thine endless praise.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
The whole creation join in one
To bless the sacred name
Of Him that sits upon the throne
And to adore the Lamb.

file: Come Let Us Sing of a Wonderul Love (Robert Walmsley).xml
title: Come Let Us Sing of a Wonderul Love

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Come, let us sing of a wonderful love,
Tender and true;
Out of the heart of the Father above,
Streaming to me and to you:
Wonderful love
Dwells in the heart of the Father above.

verses.name: v2
v3
v4
verses.text:
Come to my heart, O Thou wonderful love,
Come and abide,
Lifting my life, till it rises above
Envy and falsehood and pride,
Seeking to be
Lowly and humble, a learner of Thee.

file: Come Thou Fount (Robert Robinson).xml
title: Come Thou Fount

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Come Thou Fount of every blessing,
Tune my heart to sing Thy grace;
Streams of mercy, never ceasing,
Call for songs of loudest praise.
Teach me some melodious sonnet
Sung by flaming tongues above;
Praise the mount- I'm fixed upon it-
Mount of Thy redeeming love.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Here I raise mine Ebenezer
Hither by Thy help I'm come;
And I hope by Thy good pleasure
Safely to arrive at home.
Jesus sought me when a stranger
Wandring from the fold of God;
He to rescue me from danger
Interposed His precious blood.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
O to grace how great a debtor
Daily I'm constrained to be!
Let thy goodness like a fetter
Bind my wandring heart to Thee:
Prone to wander Lord, I feel it
Prone to leave the God I love;
Here's my heart O take and seal it,
Seal it for Thy courts above.

file: Come Ye Thankful People Come (Henry Alford).xml
title: Come Ye Thankful People Come

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Come, ye thankful people, come,
Raise the song of harvest home!
All is safely gathered in
Ere the winter storms begin;

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
God, our Maker, doth provide
For our needs to be supplied;
Come to God’s own temple, come,
Raise the song of harvest-home.

verses.name: v3
v4
verses.text:
First the blade, and then the ear,
Then the full corn shall appear:
Lord of harvest, grant that we
Wholesome grain and pure may be.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
For the Lord our God shall come
And shall take His harvest home,
From His field shall in that day
All offences purge away,

verses.name: v6
verses.text:
Give His angels charge at last
In the fire the tares to cast,
But the fruitful ears to store
In His garner evermore.

verses.name: v7
v8
verses.text:
There, forever purified,
In Thy garner to abide:
Come, with all Thine angels, come,
Raise the glorious harvest-home.

file: Come down, O Love Divine (Richard F. Littledale).xml
title: Come down, O Love Divine

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Come down, O Love Divine,
Seek Thou this soul of mine
And visit it with Thine own ardour glowing;
O Comforter, draw near,
Within my heart appear,
And kindle it, Thy holy flame bestowing.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
O let it freely burn,
Till earthly passions turn
To dust and ashes, in its heat consuming;
And let Thy glorious light
Shine ever on my sight,
And clothe me round, the while my path illuming.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Let holy charity
Mine outward vesture be,
And lowliness become mine inner clothing;
True lowliness of heart,
Which takes the humbler part,
And o'er its own shortcomings weeps with loathing.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
And so the yearning strong,
With which the soul will long,
Shall far outpass the power of human telling;
For none can guess its grace,
Till he become the place
Wherein the Holy Spirit makes His dwelling.

file: Dear Lord and Father of Mankind (John G. Whittier).xml
title: Dear Lord and Father of Mankind

verses.name: v1
v2
verses.text:
In simple trust like theirs who heard,
Beside the Syrian sea,
The gracious calling of the Lord,
Let us, like them, without a word
Rise up and follow Thee,
Rise up and follow Thee.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
O sabbath rest by Galilee!
O calm of hills above,
Where Jesus knelt to share with Thee
The silence of eternity,
Interpreted by love,
Interpreted by love.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
With that deep hush subduing all
Our words and works that drown
The tender whisper of Thy call,
As noiseless let Thy blessing fall
As fell Thy manna down,
As fell Thy manna down.
Drop Thy still dews of quietness,
Till all our strivings cease;
Take from our souls the strain and stress,
And let our ordered lives confess
The beauty of Thy peace,
The beauty of Thy peace.

verses.name: v5

file: Dios Ama ay Papurihan (Tagalog Hymn).xml
title: Dios Ama ay Papurihan

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Dios Ama ay papurihan
Dios Anak, Espiritu
Kanila’ng kal’walhatian
Dios na dakilang totoo
L’walhatiin, papurihan
Dios na walang hangganan

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
S’ya na sa’tin ay umibig
Nagligtas at naglinis
Upang tayo’y mailapit
Ang dugo N’ya ay tumigis
Sa Kanyang kal’walhatian
Kordero’y papurihan.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Angheles, bigyang papuri
Iglesia, S’ya’y itangi
Panginoon nati’t Pari
Langit, lupa’y magbubunyi
Aawitan, l’walhatiin
Hari nati’y purihin.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Walang hanggang mag-awitan
Anghel sa kalangitan
Dios na makapangyarihan
L’walhati’y magpakaylanman
O purihin, l’walhatiin
Panginoo’t Dios natin.

file: Dios Natin ay Moog na Matibay (Tagalog Hymn).xml
title: Dios Natin ay Moog na Matibay

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Dios natin ay moog ba matibay
Di natitinag na Tanggulan
Sa ati'y laging umaagapay
Tayo'y di pinababayaan
Kahit lumusob man
Ang diablong kaaway
Tayo'y walang takot
Dahil may tagumpay
Tayong sa Dios ay nananangan.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Kung sa sarili tayo manangan
Tayo'y hindi makalalaban
Kung 'di si Kristo ang aasahan
Tayo'y walang panghahawakan.
Sa pag-iingat N'ya
T'yak ang kaligtasan
Hindi masasaid
Kanyang kalakasan
Kaya S'ya ang pagtiwalaan.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Dumagsa man ang mga kaaway
Mga kampon ng kadiliman
Sila'y h'wag nating katatakutan
Dahil Dios ang ating tanggulan
Walang pagkasindak
Sa diablong Satanas
Di S’ya mananaig
Sa kapangyarihan
Ni Kristong ating Panginoon.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Tayo’y Kanyang pinagkalooban
Lahat ng ating kailangan
Upang makapaglingkod na tunay
Sa Dios Amang ating Kanlungan.
Mapawi mang lahat
Ating kayamanan
Sa buhay na ito
Walang kailangan
Hawak ng Dios ang ating buhay.

file: Doxology Tagalog (Tagalog Hymn).xml
title: Doxology Tagalog

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Ang Dios Ama'y papurihan
Anak, Espiritung Banal
Ng mga taong nilalang
At ng buong kalangitan. Amen

file: Eternal Father, strong to save (William Whiting).xml
title: Eternal Father, strong to save

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Eternal Father, strong to save,
Whose arm hath bound the restless wave,
Who bidd'st the mighty ocean deep
Its own appointed limits keep:
O hear us when we cry to Thee
For those in peril on the sea.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
O Christ, whose voice the waters heard,
And hushed their raging at Thy word,
Who walkedst on the foaming deep,
And calm amid the storm didst sleep:
O hear us when we cry to Thee
For those in peril on the sea.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
O Holy Spirit, who didst brood
Upon the waters dark and rude,
And bid their angry tumult cease,
And give, for wild confusion, peace:
O hear us when we cry to Thee
For those in peril on the sea.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
O Trinity of love and power,
Our brethren shield in danger's hour;
From rock and tempest, fire and foe,
Protect them wheresoe'er they go:
Thus evermore shall rise to Thee
Glad hymns of praise from land and sea.

file: Fight the Good Fight (John S. B. Monsell).xml
title: Fight the Good Fight

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Fight the good fight with all thy might,
Christ is thy strength, and Christ thy right;
Lay hold on life, and it shall be
Thy joy and crown eternally.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Run the straight race through God’s good grace,
Lift up thine eyes and seek His face;
Life with its way before thee lies,
Christ is the path, and Christ the prize.

verses.name: v3
v4
verses.text:
Faint not, nor fear, His arms are near,
He changeth not, and thou art dear;
Only believe, and thou shalt see
That Christ is all in all to thee.

file: Fill Thou My Life (Horatius Bonar).xml
title: Fill Thou My Life

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Fill thou my life, O Lord my God,
In every part with praise,
That my whole being may proclaim
Thy being and Thy ways.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Not for the lip of praise alone,
Nor e’en the praising heart
I ask, but for a life made up
Of praise in every part:

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Praise in the common things of life,
Its goings out and in;
Praise in each duty and each deed,
However small and mean.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Fill every part of me with praise;
Let all my being speak
Of Thee and of Thy love, O Lord,
Poor though I be and weak.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
So shall Thou, gracious Lord, from me
Receive the glory due;
And so shall I begin on earth
The song forever new.

verses.name: v6
verses.text:
So shall no part of day or night
From sacredness be free;
But all my life, in every step,
Be fellowship with Thee.

file: For All the Saints (W. W. How).xml
title: For All the Saints

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
For all the saints, who from their labours rest,
Who Thee by faith before the world confessed,
Thy name, O Jesus, be forever blest.
Hallelujah! Hallelujah!

verses.name: v2
v3
verses.text:
O may Thy soldiers, faithful, true and bold,
Fight as the saints who nobly fought of old,
And win, with them, the victor’s crown of gold!
Hallelujah! Hallelujah!
O blest communion, fellowship divine!
We feebly struggle, they in glory shine;
Yet all are one in Thee, for all are Thine.
Hallelujah! Hallelujah!

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
And when the strife is fierce, the warfare long,
Steals on the ear the distant triumph song,
And hearts are brave again, and arms are strong.
Hallelujah! Hallelujah!

verses.name: v5
v6
v7
verses.text:
From earth’s wide bounds, from ocean’s farthest coast,
Through gates of pearl streams in the countless host,
Singing to Father, Son and Holy Ghost.
Hallelujah! Hallelujah!

file: For Unto us a Child is Born (Author Unknown).xml
title: For Unto us a Child is Born

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
For unto us a child is born,
Unto us a Son is given.
And the government shall be upon His shoulder,
And His name shall be called
Wonderful Counsellor, the Mighty God,
The Everlasting Father,
And the Prince of Peace is He.

file: For the Beauty of the Earth (Folliot S. Pierpoint).xml
title: For the Beauty of the Earth

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
For the beauty of the earth,
For the beauty of the skies,
For the love which from our birth
Over and around us lies:
Father, unto Thee we raise
This our sacrifice of praise.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
For the beauty of each hour
Of the day and of the night,
Hill and vale, and tree and flower,
Sun and moon, and stars of light:
Father, unto Thee we raise
This our sacrifice of praise.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
For the joy of human love,
Brother, sister, parent, child,
Friends on earth, and friends above;
For all gentle thoughts and mild:
Father, unto Thee we raise
This our sacrifice of praise.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
For each perfect gift of Thine
To our race so freely given,
Graces, human and divine,
Flowers of earth, and buds of heaven:
Father, unto Thee we raise
This our sacrifice of praise.

file: Forth in Thy Name, O Lord, I Go (Charles Wesley).xml
title: Forth in Thy Name, O Lord, I Go

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Forth in Thy name, O Lord, I go,
My daily labour to pursue,
Thee, only Thee, resolved to know
In all I think, or speak, or do.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
The task Thy wisdom hath assigned
O let me cheerfully fulfil;
In all my works Thy presence find,
And prove Thy acceptable will.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Thee may I set at my right hand,
Whose eyes my inmost substance see;
And labour on at Thy command,
And offer all my works to Thee.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Give me to bear Thy easy yoke,
And every moment watch and pray,
And still to things eternal look,
And hasten to Thy glorious day.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
For Thee delightfully employ
Whate'er Thy bounteous grace hath given,
And run my course with even joy,
And closely walk with Thee to heaven.

file: From All That Dwell Below the Skies (Isaac Watts).xml
title: From All That Dwell Below the Skies

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
From all that dwell below the skies
Let the Creator’s praise arise:
Alleluia! Alleluia!
Let the Redeemer’s name be sung
Through every land, by every tongue.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Alleluia! Alleluia!
Alleluia! Alleluia!
Alleluia!

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Eternal are Thy mercies, Lord;
Eternal truth attends Thy word:
Alleluia! Alleluia!
Thy praise shall sound from shore to shore,
Till suns shall rise and set no more.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Your lofty themes, ye mortals, bring,
In songs of praise divinely sing:
Alleluia! Alleluia!
The great salvation loud proclaim,
And shout for joy the Saviour’s name.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
In every land begin the song;
To every land the strains belong.
Alleluia! Alleluia!
In cheerful sounds all voices raise,
And fill the world with loudest praise.

file: Give me oil in my Lamp (Author Unknown).xml
title: Give me oil in my Lamp

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Give me oil in my lamp, keep me burning.
Give me oil in my lamp, I pray.
Give me oil in my lamp, keep my burning,
Keep me burning till the break of day.

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
Sing hosanna, sing hosanna,
Sing hosanna to the King of kings.
Sing hosanna, sing hosanna,
Sing hosanna to the King.

verses.name: v2
verses.text: Give me joy in my heart, keep me praising…

verses.name: v3
verses.text: Give me peace in my heart, keep me resting…

verses.name: v4
verses.text: Give me love in my heart, keep me serving…

file: Glorious Things of Thee are Spoken (John Newton).xml
title: Glorious Things of Thee are Spoken

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Glorious things of Thee are spoken,
Zion, city of our God!
He whose word cannot be broken
Formed thee for His own abode.
On the Rock of Ages founded,
What can shake thy sure repose?
With salvation’s walls surrounded,
Thou mayest smile at all thy foes.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
See! The streams of living waters,
Springing from eternal love,
Well supply thy sons and daughters,
And all fear of want remove;
Who can faint, whilst such a river
Ever flows their thirst to assuage?
Grace which, like the Lord, the Giver,
Never fails from age to age.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Round each habitation hovering,
See the cloud and fire appear!
For a glory and a covering,
Showing that the Lord is near.
He who gives them daily manna,
He who listens when they cry:
Let Him hear the loud hosanna
Rising to His throne on high.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Saviour, if of Zion’s city
I, through grace, a member am,
Let the world deride or pity,
I will glory in Thy name.
Fading is the worldling’s pleasure,
All his boasted pomp and show,
Solid joys and lasting treasure
None but Zion’s children know.

file: God is Working His Purpose Out (Arthur C. Ainger).xml
title: God is Working His Purpose Out

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
God is working His purpose out,
As year succeeds to year;
God is working His purpose out,
And the time is drawing near;
Nearer and nearer draws the time,
The time that shall surely be,
When the earth shall be filled
With the glory of God,
As the waters cover the sea.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
From utmost East to utmost West,
Where’er man’s foot hath trod,
By the mouth of many messengers
Goes forth the voice of God;
Give ear to Me, ye continents,
Ye isles, give ear to Me,
That the earth may be filled
With the glory of God,
As the waters cover the sea.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
March we forth in the strength of God
With the banner of Christ unfurled,
That the light of the glorious gospel of truth
May shine throughout the world:
Fight we the fight with sorrow and sin,
To set their captives free,
That the earth may be filled
With the glory of God,
As the waters cover the sea.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
All we can do is nothing worth,
Unless God blesses the deed;
Vainly we hope for the harvest-tide
Till God gives life to the seed;
Yet nearer and nearer draws the time,
The time that shall surely be,
When the earth shall be filled
With the glory of God,
As the waters cover the sea.

file: God is so Good (Author Unknown).xml
title: God is so Good

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
God is so good,
God is so good,
God is so good,
He’s so good to me.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
He took my sin,
He took my sin,
He took my sin,
He’s so good to me.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Now I am free,
Now I am free,
Now I am free,
He’s so good to me.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
God is so good,
He took my sin,
Now I am free,
He’s so good to me.

file: God of Grace and God of Glory (H. E. Fosdick).xml
title: God of Grace and God of Glory

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
God of grace and God of glory,
On Thy people pour Thy power;
Crown Thine ancient church’s story;
Bring her bud to glorious flower.
Grant us wisdom,
Grant us courage,
For the facing of this hour.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Lo! the hosts of evil round us
Scorn Thy Christ, assail His ways!
Fears and doubts too long have bound us;
Free our hearts to work and praise.
Grant us wisdom,
Grant us courage,
For the living of these days.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Heal Thy children’s warring madness;
Bend our pride to Thy control;
Shame our wanton, selfish gladness,
Rich in things and poor in soul.
Grant us wisdom,
Grant us courage,
Lest we miss Thy kingdom’s goal.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Set our feet on lofty places;
Gird our lives that they may be
Armoured with all Christlike graces
In the fight to set men free.
Grant us wisdom,
Grant us courage,
That we fail not man nor Thee.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
Save us from weak resignation
To the evils we deplore;
Let the search for Thy salvation
Be our glory ever more.
Grant us wisdom,
Grant us courage,
Serving Thee whom we adore.

file: Good Christian Men Rejoice (John Mason Neale).xml
title: Good Christian Men Rejoice

verses.name: v1
v2
verses.text:
Good Christian men, rejoice
With heart and soul and voice;
Now ye hear of endless bliss,
Jesus Christ was born for this:
He hath opened heaven’s door
And man is blessed forever more.
Christ was born for this;
Christ was born for this!

verses.name: v3

file: Great is the Lord (Author Unknown).xml
title: Great is the Lord

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Great is the Lord and greatly to be praised,
In the city of our God,
In the mountain of His holiness.
Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
One body, one Spirit, one faith, one Lord,
One people, one nation, praise ye the Lord.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Is Mount Zion on the sides of the north,
The city of the great King,
Is Mount Zion on the sides of the north,
The city of the great King.

file: Guide Me O Thou Great Jehovah (William Williams).xml
title: Guide Me O Thou Great Jehovah

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Guide me, O thou great Jehovah,
Pilgrim through this barren land;
I am weak, but Thou art mighty,
Hold me with Thy powerful hand:
Bread of heaven, Bread of heaven,
Feed me now and ever more,
Feed me now and ever more.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Open Thou the crystal fountain
Whence the healing stream doth flow;
Let the fiery, cloudy pillar
Lead me all my journey through:
Strong Deliverer, strong Deliverer,
Be Thou still my strength and shield,
Be Thou still my strength and shield.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
When I tread the verge of Jordan
Bid my anxious fears subside;
Death of death, and hell’s destruction,
Land me safe on Canaan’s side:
Songs of praises, songs of praises,
I will ever give to Thee,
I will ever give to Thee.

file: Hail Thou Once Despised Jesus (John Bakewell).xml
title: Hail Thou Once Despised Jesus

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Hail, thou once despised Jesus,
Hail, Thou Galilean King!
Thou didst suffer to release us,
Thou didst free salvation bring.
Hail, Thou agonising Saviour,
Bearer of our sin and shame;
By Thy merits we find favour,
Life is given through Thy name.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Paschal Lamb, by God appointed,
All our sins on Thee were laid.
With almighty love anointed
Thou hast full atonement made.
All Thy people are forgiven
Through the virtue of Thy blood:
Opened is the gate of heaven,
Man is reconciled to God.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Jesus, hail! enthroned in glory,
There forever to abide;
All the heavenly hosts adore Thee,
Seated at Thy Father’s side:
There for sinners Thou art pleading,
There Thou dost our place prepare,
Ever for us interceding,
Till in glory we appear.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Worship, honour, power, and blessing
Thou art worthy to receive:
Loudest praises, without ceasing,
Right it is for us to give:
Come, O mighty Holy Spirit,
As our hearts and hands we raise,
Help us sing our Saviour’s merits,
Help us sing Immanuel’s praise.

file: Hail to the Lord_s Annointed (James Montgomery).xml
title: Hail to the Lord's Annointed

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Hail to the Lord's anointed,
Great David’s greater Son!
Hail, in the time appointed,
His reign on earth begun!
He comes to break oppression,
To set the captive free,
To take away transgression,
And rule in equity.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
He comes, with succour speedy,
To those who suffer wrong;
To help the poor and needy,
And bid the weak be strong;
To give them songs for sighing,
Their darkness turn to light,
Whose souls, condemned and dying,
Were precious in His sight.

verses.name: v3
v4
verses.text:
Kings shall fall down before Him,
And gold and incense bring;
All nations shall adore Him,
His praise all people sing;
To Him shall prayer unceasing
And daily vows ascend,
His kingdom still increasing,
A kingdom without end.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
O’er every foe victorious,
He on His throne shall rest;
From age to age more glorious,
All-blessing and all-blessed.
The tide of time shall never
His covenant remove;
His name shall stand forever,
His changeless name of Love.

file: Hallelujah Sing to Jesus (W. C. Dix).xml
title: Hallelujah Sing to Jesus

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Hallelujah! Sing to Jesus;
His the sceptre, His the throne;
Hallelujah! His the triumph,
His the victory alone.
Hark, the songs of holy Zion
Thunder like a mighty flood:
‘Jesus out of every nation
Hath redeemed us by His blood.’

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Hallelujah! not as orphans
Are we left in sorrow now;
Hallelujah! He is near us,
Faith believes, nor questions how.
Though the clouds from sight receivedHim
When the forty days were o’er,
Shall our hearts forget His promise,
‘I am with you ever more’?

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Hallelujah! Bread of heaven,
Thou on earth our food, our stay;
Hallelujah! here the sinful
Flee to Thee from day to day.
Intercessor, Friend of sinners,
Earth’s Redeemer, plead for me
Where the songs of all the sinless
Sweep across the crystal sea.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Hallelujah! sing to Jesus;
His the sceptre, His the throne;
Hallelujah! His the triumph,
His the victory alone.
Hark, the songs of holy Zion
Thunder like a mighty flood:
‘Jesus out of every nation
Hath redeemed us by His blood.’

file: Hari_y Sambahin (Tagalog Hymn).xml
title: Hari'y Sambahin

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Hari'y sambahin ng kalangitan
Awiting Kanyang kapangyarihan
Tanggulan sa buong kapanahunan
Napaligiran ng kal'walhatian.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Biyaya't lakas N'ya'y ipahayag
S'yang nababalutan ng liwanag
Sasakyan N'ya'ng maiitim na ulap
Bagyong madilim ay ang Kanyang landas.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Kalinga Mo sa'min ay sagana
Sa hangi't liwanag nadarama
Sa sangkalikasan ay nakikita
Dala ng ula't hamog sa umaga

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Mga marupok kaming nilikha
Sa'Yo'y lubusang nagtitiwala
Kabutihan Mo'y hanggang katapusan
Aming Manlilikha at Kaligtasan.

file: Hark the Glad Sound (Philip Doddridge).xml
title: Hark the Glad Sound

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Hark the glad sound! The Saviour comes,
The Saviour promised long;
Let every heart prepare a throne,
And every voice a song.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
He comes the prisoners to release,
In Satan’s bondage held;
The gates of brass before Him burst,
The iron fetters yield.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
He comes the broken heart to bind,
The bleeding soul to cure,
And with the treasures of His grace
To enrich the humble poor.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Our glad hosannas, Prince of Peace,
Thy welcome shall proclaim;
And heaven’s eternal arches ring
With Thy beloved name.

file: Have Thine Own Way, Lord! (Adelaide A. Pollard).xml
title: Have Thine Own Way, Lord!

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Have Thine own way, Lord! Have Thine own way!
Thou art the Potter, I am the clay:
Mould me and make me After thy will,
While I am waiting, Yielded and still.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Have Thine own way, Lord! Have Thine own way!
Search me and try me, Master today!
Whiter than snow, Lord, Wash me just now,
As in Thy presence Humbly I bow.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Have Thine own way, Lord! Have Thine own way!
Wounded and weary, Help me, I pray!
Power, all power,Surely is Thine!
Touch me and heal me, Savior divine!

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Have Thine own way, Lord! Have Thine own way!
Hold o'er my being Absolute sway!
Fill with Thy Spirit Till all shall see
Christ only, always, Living in me!

file: He Took My Sins Away (Mrs. M.J.H.).xml
title: He Took My Sins Away

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
I came to Jesus, weary, worn and sad,
He took my sins away, He took my sins away,
And now His love has made my heart so glad,
He took my sins away.

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
He took my sins away, He took my sins away,
And keeps me singing everyday!
I'm so glad He took my sins away,
He took my sins away.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
The load of sin was more than I could bear,
He took them all away, He took them all away,
And now on Him I roll my every care,
He took my sins away.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
No condemnation have I in my heart,
He took my sins away, He took my sins away,
His perfect peace He did to me impart,
He took my sins away.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
If you will come to Jesus Christ today,
He'll take your sins away, He'll take your sins away,
And keep you happy in His love each day,
He'll take your sins away.

file: He Who Would Valiant Be (John Bunyan).xml
title: He Who Would Valiant Be

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
He who would valiant be
’Gainst all disaster,
Let him in constancy
Follow the Master.
There’s no discouragement
Shall make him once relent
His first avowed intent
To be a pilgrim.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Who so beset him round
With dismal stories,
Do but themselves confound—
His strength the more is.
No foes shall stay his might,
Though he with giants fight;
He will make good his right
To be a pilgrim.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Since, Lord, Thou dost defend
Us with Thy Spirit,
We know we at the end
Shall life inherit.
Then fancies flee away!
I’ll fear not what men say,
I’ll labour night and day
To be a pilgrim.

file: He is Lord (Author Unknown).xml
title: He is Lord

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
He is Lord, He is Lord,
He is risen from the dead
And He is Lord.
Every knee shall bow,
Every tongue confess
That Jesus Christ is Lord.

file: Heavenly Father I Appreciate You (Author Unknown).xml
title: Heavenly Father I Appreciate You

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Heavenly Father, I appreciate You.
Heavenly Father, I appreciate You.
I love You, adore You,
I bow down before You.
Heavenly Father, I appreciate You.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Son of God, what a wonder You are.
Son of God, what a wonder You are.
You cleansed my soul from sin,
You set the Holy Ghost within.
Son of God, what a wonder You are.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Holy Ghost, what a comfort You are.
Holy Ghost, what a comfort You are.
You lead us, You guide us,
You live right inside us.
Holy Ghost, what a comfort You are.

file: Here is Love (William Rees).xml
title: Here is Love

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Here is love vast as the ocean,
Loving kindness as the flood,
When the Prince of life, our ransom
Shed for us His precious blood.
Who His love will not remember?
Who can cease to sing His praise?
He can never be forgotten
Throughout heaven’s eternal days.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
On the Mount of Crucifixion
Fountains opened deep and wide;
Through the floodgates of God’s mercy
Flowed a vast and gracious tide.
Grace and love, like mighty rivers,
Poured incessant from above,
And heaven’s peace and perfect justice
Kissed a guilty world in love.

file: His Name is Higher (Author Unknown).xml
title: His Name is Higher

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
His name is higher than any other,
His name is Jesus, His name is Lord.
His name is Wonderful,
His name is Counsellor,
His name is Prince of Peace,
The mighty God.
His name is higher than any other,
His name is Jesus, His name is Lord.

file: Holy Holy Holy Lord God Almighty (Reginald Heber).xml
title: Holy Holy Holy Lord God Almighty

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Holy, Holy, Holy, Lord God Almighty! 
Early in the morning our song shall rise to Thee; 
Holy, Holy, Holy! Merciful and Mighty! 
God in Three Persons, blessed Trinity!

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Holy, Holy, Holy! All the saints adore Thee,
Casting down their golden crowns around the glassy sea; 
Cherubim and seraphim falling down before Thee, 
Which were and art and evermore shalt be.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Holy, Holy, Holy! Tho the darkness hide Thee, 
Tho the eye of sinful man Thy glory may not see; 
Only Thou art holy there is none beside Thee 
Perfect in pow'r, in love and purity.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Holy, Holy, Holy, Lord God Almighty! 
All Thy works shall praise Thy name in earth and sky and sea; 
Holy, Holy, Holy! Merciful and Mighty! 
God in Three Persons, blessed Trinity!

file: Hover O_er Me (Elwood H. Stokes).xml
title: Hover O'er Me

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Hover o'er me, Holy Spirit,
Bathe my trembling heart and brow;
Fill me with Thy hallowed presence,
Come, O come and fill me now.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Fill me now, fill me now,
Jesus, come and fill me now.
Fill me with Thy hallowed presence,
Jesus, come and fill me now.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Thou can fill me, gracious Spirit,
Though I cannot tell Thee how;
But I need Thee, greatly need Thee,
Come, O come and fill me now.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
I am weakness, full of weakness,
At Thy sacred feet I bow;
Blest, divine, eternal Spirit,
Come with power, and fill me now.

file: How Lovely is Thy Dwelling (Author Unknown).xml
title: How Lovely is Thy Dwelling

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
How lovely is thy dwelling place,
O Lord of hosts,
My soul longs and yearns for Your courts,
And my heart and flesh sing for joy
To the living God.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
One day in Your presence
Is far better to me than gold,
Or to live my whole life somewhere else;
And I would rather be
A doorkeeper in Your house

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Than to take my fate upon myself.
You are my sun and my shield,
You are my lover from the start,
And the highway to Your city
Runs through my heart.

file: How Sweet the name of Jesus Sounds (John Newton).xml
title: How Sweet the name of Jesus Sounds

verses.name: v1a
verses.text:
How sweet the name of Jesus sounds
In a believer’s ear!
It soothes his sorrows, heals his wounds,
And drives away his fear.

verses.name: v1b
verses.text:
It makes the wounded spirit whole,
And calms the troubled breast;
’Tis manna to the hungry soul,
And to the weary, rest.

verses.name: v2a
verses.text:
Dear name, the rock on which I build,
My shield and hiding place,
My never-failing treasury, filled
With boundless stores of grace!

verses.name: v2b
verses.text:
Jesus! My Shepherd, Saviour, Friend,
My Prophet, Priest and King,
My Lord, my Life, my Way, my End,
Accept the praise I bring.

verses.name: v3a
verses.text:
Weak is the effort of my heart,
And cold my warmest thought;
But when I see Thee as Thou art,
I’ll praise Thee as I ought.

verses.name: v3b
verses.text:
Till then I would Thy love proclaim
With every fleeting breath;
And may the music of Thy name
Refresh my soul in death.

file: I Cannot Tell (William Y. Fullerton).xml
title: I Cannot Tell

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
I cannot tell why He, whom angels worship,
Should set His love upon the sons of men,
Or why, as Shepherd, He should seek the wanderers,
To bring them back, they know not how or when.
But this I know, that He was born of Mary,
When Bethlehem’s manger was His only home,
And that He lived at Nazareth and laboured,
And so the Saviour, Saviour of the world, is come.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
I cannot tell how silently He suffered,
As with His peace He graced this place of tears,
Or how His heart upon the cross wasbroken,
The crown of pain to three-and-thirty years.
But this I know, He heals the broken-hearted,
And stays our sin, and calms our lurkingfear,
And lifts the burden from the heavy-laden,
For yet the Saviour, Saviour of the world, is here.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
I cannot tell how He will win the nations,
How He will claim His earthly heritage,
How satisfy the needs and aspirations
Of east and west, of sinner and of sage.
But this I know, all flesh shall see His glory,
And He shall reap the harvest He has sown,
And some glad day His sun shall shine in splendour,
When He the Saviour, Saviour of the world, is known.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
I cannot tell how all the lands shall worship,
When, at his bidding, every storm is stilled,
Or who can say how great the jubilation
When all the hearts of men with love are filled.
But this I know, the skies will thrill with rapture,
And myriad, myriad human voices sing,
And earth to heaven, and heaven to earth, will answer:
‘At last the Saviour, Saviour of the world, is King!’

file: I Gave My Life for Thee (Frances R. Havergal).xml
title: I Gave My Life for Thee

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
I gave my life for Thee, 
My precious blood I shed,
That thou might's ransomed be,
And quickened from the dead

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
I gave, I gave my life for thee
What hast thou giv'n for me?
I gave, I gave my life for thee
What hast thou giv'n for me?

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
My Father's house of light,
My glory circled throne
I left, for earthly night,
For wandrings sad and lone;

verses.name: c2
verses.text:
I left, I left it all for thee
Hast thou left aught for me?
I left, I left it all for thee
Hast thou left aught for me?

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
I suffered much for Thee,
More than thy tongue can tell,
Of bittr'est agony, 
To rescue  thee from hell;

verses.name: c3
verses.text:
I've borne, I've borne it all for thee
What has thou borne for me?
I've borne, I've borne it all for thee
What has thou borne for me?

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
And I have brought to thee,
Down from my home above,
Salvation full and free,
My pardon and my love;

verses.name: c4
verses.text:
I bring, I bring rich gifts to thee
What has thou brought to me?
I bring, I bring rich gifts to thee
What has thou brought to me?

file: I Heard the Voice of Jesus Say (Horatius Bonar).xml
title: I Heard the Voice of Jesus Say

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
I heard the voice of Jesus say:
‘Come unto Me and rest;
Lay down, thou weary one, lay down
Thy head upon My breast.’
I came to Jesus as I was,
Weary and worn and sad;
I found in Him a resting place,
And He has made me glad.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
I heard the voice of Jesus say:
‘Behold I freely give
The living water, thirsty one,
Stoop down and drink and live.’
I came to Jesus, and I drank
Of that life-giving stream;
My thirst was quenched, my soul revived,

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
And now I live in Him.
I heard the voice of Jesus say:
‘I am this dark world’s light;
Look unto Me, thy morn shall rise,
And all thy day be bright.’
I looked to Jesus, and I found
In Him my Star, my Sun;
And in that light of life I’ll walk,
Till travelling days are done.

file: I Know Not Why God_s Wondrous Grace (D. W. Whittle).xml
title: I Know Not Why God's Wondrous Grace

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
I know not why God's wondrous grace
To me hath been made known;
Nor why, unworthy as I am,
He claimed me for His own.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
But I know whom I have believed;
And am persuaded that He is able
To keep that which I’ve committed
Unto Him against that day.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
I know not how this saving faith
To me He did impart;
Or how believing in His word
Wrought peace within my heart.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
I know not how the Spirit moves,
Convincing men of sin;
Revealing Jesus through the word,
Creating faith in Him.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
I know not what of good or ill
May be reserved for me,
Of weary ways or golden days
Before His face I see.

verses.name: v6

file: I See the Lord (Author Unknown).xml
title: I See the Lord

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
I see the Lord, I see the Lord,
He is high and lifted up
And His train fills the temple.
He is high and lifted up
And His train fills the temple.
The angels cry, Holy,
The angels cry, Holy,
The angels cry, Holy is the Lord.

file: I Will Song of the Mercies (J. H. Fillmore).xml
title: I Will Song of the Mercies

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
I will sing of the mercies of the Lord for ever,
I will sing, I will sing.
I will sing of the mercies of the Lord for ever,
I will sing of the mercies of the Lord.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
With my mouth will I make known
Thy faithfulness, Thy faithfulness.
With my mouth will I make known
Thy faithfulness to all generations.

file: I am Thine, O Lord (Adelaide A. Pollard).xml
title: I am Thine, O Lord

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
I am Thine ,O Lord- I have heard Thy voice,
And it told Thy love to me
But I long to rise in the arms of faith
And be closer drawn to Thee.

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
Draw me nearer, nearer blessed Lord, 
To the cross where Thou hast died;
Draw me nearer, nearer, nearer blessed Lord,
To Thy precious , bleeding side.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Consecrate me now to Thy service, Lord,
By the pow'r of grace divine;
Let my soul look up with a steadfast hope
And my will be lost in Thine.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
O the pure delight of a single hour
That before Thy throne I spend;
When I kneel in pray'r and with Thee, my God,
I commune as friend with friend.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
There are depths of love that I cannot know
Till I cross the narrow sea; 
There are heights of joy that I may not reach
Till I rest in peace with Thee.

file: I am Trusting Thee Lord Jesus (Frances Ridley Havergal).xml
title: I am Trusting Thee Lord Jesus

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
I am trusting Thee, Lord Jesus,
Trusting only Thee!
Trusting Thee for full salvation,
Great and free.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
I am trusting Thee for pardon,
At Thy feet I bow;
For Thy grace and tender mercy,
Trusting now.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
I am trusting Thee for cleansing
In the crimson flood;
Trusting Thee to make me holy,
By Thy blood.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
I am trusting Thee for power,
Thine can never fail;
Words which Thou Thyself shalt give me
Must prevail.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
I am trusting Thee to guide me,
Thou alone shalt lead;
Every day and hour supplying
All my need.

verses.name: v6

file: Ialay sa Panginoon (Tagalog Hymn).xml
title: Ialay sa Panginoon

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Ialay sa Panginoon
Taglay mong kalakasan
Humayo at ipaglaban
Kanyang katotohanan
Si Kristo’ng ating huwaran
Buong pusong maglingkod
Alayan ng katapatan
Buong lakas ihandog.

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
Ialay sa Panginoon
Taglay mong kalakasan
Ang kanyang katotohanan
Ay ating ipaglaban.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Ialay sa Panginoon
Buong puso mo’t buhay
Paglingkuran mong lubusan
Lahat-lahat ibigay.
Dios sa kanyang kabutihan
Bugtong Anak inalay
Paglingkuran Syang lubusan
Pasalamat ibigay.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Ialay sa Panginoon
Ang iyong lahat-lahat
Para sa’ting katubusan
Lwalhati’y iniwanan.
Hinandog N’ya’ng Kanyang buhay
Para sa kaligtasan
Papuri’y ating ialay
Atin S’yang parangalan.

file: Ibigin ang Kapwa (Tagalog Hymn).xml
title: Ibigin ang Kapwa

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Ibigin ang kapwa ang maging nasa
Buhay ni Hesus ay ibalita,
Igawad ang awa at pagpapala
Sa sinumang napapariwara.

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
Akayin sa lingap ang nalilinsad
Sa Dios na may habag nang maligtas.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Sakaling aayaw ay pag tamanang
Pilitin sa mga kagalingan.
Hanggang sa maparam ang kadiliman,
S'ya ay kusaing pagtiyagaan.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Sa dibdib na tigib ng salang dungis
Ang kaligtasan ay s'yang ipilit,
Na doo'y masilid; at nang sumapit
Sa paa ni Hesus ay ihatid.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Ituro ang tungkol sa kaligtasan, 
Tulong ni Hesus iyong asahan,
S'ya ang aagapay ng kalakasan
Tatamuhin magpawalanghanggan.

file: Immortal Invisible (Walter Chalmers Smith).xml
title: Immortal Invisible

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Immortal, invisible, God only wise,
In light inaccessible hid from our eyes,
Most blessed, most glorious, the Ancient of Days,
Almighty, victorious, Thy great name we praise.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Unresting, unhasting, and silent as light,
Nor wanting, nor wasting, Thou rulest in might;
Thy justice like mountains high soaring above
Thy clouds which are fountains of goodness and love.

verses.name: v3
v4
verses.text:
Great Father of glory, pure Father of light,
Thine angels adore Thee, all veiling their sight;
All laud we would render: O help us to see
’Tis only the splendour of light hideth Thee.

file: In Heavenly Love Abiding (Anna L. Waring).xml
title: In Heavenly Love Abiding

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
In heavenly love abiding,
No change my heart shall fear;
And safe is such confiding,
For nothing changes here:
The storm may roar without me,
My heart may low be laid;
But God is round about me,
And can I be dismayed?

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Wherever He may guide me,
No want shall turn me back;
My Shepherd is beside me,
And nothing can I lack:
His wisdom ever waketh,
His sight is never dim;
He knows the way He taketh,
And I will walk with Him.

verses.name: v3

file: In the Bleak Midwinter (Christina G. Rosetti).xml
title: In the Bleak Midwinter

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
In the bleak midwinter,
Frosty wind made moan;
Earth stood hard as iron,
Water like a stone.
Snow had fallen, snow on snow,
Snow on snow;
In the bleak midwinter,
Long ago.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Our God, heaven cannot hold Him,
Nor earth sustain,
Heaven and earth shall flee away
When He comes to reign.
In the bleak midwinter
A stable-place sufficed
The Lord God Almighty,
Jesus Christ.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Angels and archangels
May have gathered there,
Cherubim and seraphim
Thronged the air.
But His mother only,
In her maiden bliss,
Worshipped the Beloved
With a kiss.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
What can I give Him,
Poor as I am?
If I were a shepherd,
I would bring a lamb.
If I were a wise man,
I would do my part;
Yet what I can I give Him --
Give my heart.

file: In the Name of Jesus (Author Unknown).xml
title: In the Name of Jesus

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
In the name of Jesus,
In the name of Jesus,
We have the victory.
In the name of Jesus,
In the name of Jesus,
Demons will have to flee.
Who can tell what God can do?
Who can tell of His love for you?
In the name of Jesus, Jesus,
We have the victory.

file: It Came Upon a Midnight Clear (E. H. Sears).xml
title: It Came Upon a Midnight Clear

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
It came upon a midnight clear,
That glorious song of old,
From angels bending near the earth
To touch their harps of gold:
‘Peace on the earth, goodwill to men
From heaven’s all gracious King!’
The world in solemn stillness lay
To hear the angels sing.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Still through the cloven skies they come,
With peaceful wings unfurled,
And still their heavenly music floats
O’er all the weary world:
Above its sad and lowly plains
They bend on hovering wing,
And ever o’er its Babel sounds
The blessed angels sing.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Yet with woes of sin and strife
The world has suffered long,
Beneath the angel-strain have rolled
Two thousand years of wrong;
And man, at war with man, hears not
The love-song which they bring:
O hush the noise, ye men of strife,
And hear the angels sing.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
For lo! the days are hastening on,
By prophet bards foretold,
When with the ever-circling years
Comes round the age of gold;
When peace shall over all the earth
Its ancient splendours fling,
And all the world send back the song
Which now the angels sing.

file: It is a Thing Most Wonderful (W. W. How).xml
title: It is a Thing Most Wonderful

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
It is a thing most wonderful,
Almost too wonderful to be,
That God’s own Son should come from heaven
And die to save a child like me.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
And yet I know that it is true;
He came to this poor world below,
And wept, and toiled, and mourned, and died,
Only because He loved us so.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
I cannot tell how He could love
A child so weak and full of sin;
His love must be most wonderful,
If He could die my love to win.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
It is most wonderful to know
His love for me so free and sure;
But ’tis more wonderful to see
My love for Him so faint and poor.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
And yet I want to love Thee, Lord;
O light the flame within my heart,
And I will love Thee more and more,
Until I see Thee as Thou art.

file: Jesus Christ is Risen Today (Lyra Davidica).xml
title: Jesus Christ is Risen Today

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Jesus Christ is risen today; Hallelujah!
Our triumphant holy day; Hallelujah!
Who did once upon the cross; Hallelujah!
Suffer to redeem our loss; Hallelujah!

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Hymns of praise then let us sing; Hallelujah!
Unto Christ our heavenly King; Hallelujah!
Who endured the cross and grave; Hallelujah!
Sinners to redeem and save: Hallelujah!

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
But the pains which He endured; Hallelujah!
Our salvation have procured; Hallelujah!
Now in heaven above He’s King; Hallelujah!
Where the angels ever sing: Hallelujah!

file: Jesus Lives (Chrisitan F. Gellert).xml
title: Jesus Lives

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Jesus lives! thy terrors now
Can, O death, no more appal us;
Jesus lives! by this we know,
Thou, O grave, canst not enthral us.
Hallelujah!

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Jesus lives! henceforth is death
But the gate of life immortal;
This shall calm our trembling breath,
When we pass its gloomy portal.
Hallelujah!

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Jesus lives! for us He died;
Then, alone to Jesus living,
Pure in heart may we abide,
Glory to our Saviour giving.
Hallelujah!

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Jesus lives! our hearts know well,
Naught from us His love shall sever;
Life, nor death, nor powers of hell,
Tear us from His keeping ever.
Hallelujah!

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
Jesus lives! to Him the throne
Over all the world is given:
May we go where He is gone,
Rest and reign with Him in heaven.
Hallelujah!

file: Jesus Lover of My Soul (Charles Wesley).xml
title: Jesus Lover of My Soul

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Jesus, lover of my soul,
Let me to Thy bosom fly,
While the nearer waters roll,
While the tempest still is high;
Hide me, O my Saviour, hide,
Till the storm of life is past;
Safe into the haven guide,
O receive my soul at last.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Other refuge have I none,
Hangs my helpless soul on Thee;
Leave, ah, leave me not alone,
Still support and comfort me.
All my trust on Thee is stayed,
All my help from Thee I bring;
Cover my defenceless head
With the shadow of Thy wing.

verses.name: v3
v4

file: Jesus Shall Reign (Isaac Watts).xml
title: Jesus Shall Reign

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Jesus shall reign where’er the sun
Doth his successive journeys run;
His kingdom stretch from shore to shore,
Till moons shall wax and wane no more.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
For Him shall endless prayer be made,
And praises throng to crown His head;
His name like sweet perfume shall rise
With every morning sacrifice.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
People and realms of every tongue
Dwell on His love with sweetest song,
And infant voices shall proclaim
Their early blessings on His name.

verses.name: v4
v5
verses.text:
Let every creature rise and bring
Peculiar honours to our King;
Angels descend with songs again,
And earth repeat the loud Amen!

file: Jesus Stand Among Us (William Pennefather).xml
title: Jesus Stand Among Us

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Jesus stand among us,
In Thy risen power,
Let this time of worship
Be a hallowed hour.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Breathe Thy Holy Spirit
Into every heart,
Bid the fears and sorrows
From each soul depart.
Thus with quickened footsteps
We’ll pursue our way,
Watching for the dawning
Of eternal day.

file: Jesus is Calling (Fanny Crosby).xml
title: Jesus is Calling

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Jesus is tenderly calling thee home 
Calling today, calling today;
Why from the sun-shine of love wilt thou roam
Farther and farther away?

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
Calling today, calling today 
Jesus is calling, is tenderly calling today.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Jesus is calling, the weary to rest 
Calling today, calling today;
Bring Him thy burden and thou salt be blest
He will not turn thee away.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Jesus is waiting, O come to him now
Waiting today, waiting today;
Come with thy sins. At His feet lowly bow
Come and no longer delay.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Jesus is pleading, O list to His voice 
Hear him today, hear him today;
They who believe on His name shall rejoice
Quickly arise and away.

file: Jesus the Name High Over All (Charles Wesley).xml
title: Jesus the Name High Over All

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Jesus! The name high over all,
In hell, or earth, or sky;
Angels and men before it fall,
And devils fear and fly,
And devils fear and fly.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Jesus! the name to sinners dear,
The name to sinners given;
It scatters all their guilty fear,
It turns their hell to heaven,
It turns their hell to heaven.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Jesus! the prisoners’ fetters breaks,
And bruises Satan’s head;
Power into strengthless souls it speaks,
And life into the dead,
And life into the dead.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
O that the world might taste and see
The riches of His grace!
The arms of love that compass me
Would all mankind embrace,
Would all mankind embrace.
His only righteousness I show,
His saving grace proclaim;
’Tis all my business here below
To cry: ‘Behold the Lamb!’
To cry: ‘Behold the Lamb!’

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
Happy if with my latest breath
I might but gasp His name;
Preach Him to all, and cry in death:
‘Behold, behold the Lamb!’
‘Behold, behold the Lamb!’

file: Join All the Glorious Names (Isaac Watts).xml
title: Join All the Glorious Names

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Join all the glorious names,
Of wisdom, love, and power,
That ever mortals knew,
That angels ever bore:
All are too mean to speak His worth,
Too mean to set my Saviour forth.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Great Prophet of my God,
My tongue would bless Thy name:
By Thee the joyful news
Of our salvation came:
The joyful news of sins forgiven,
Of hell subdued and peace with heaven.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Jesus, my great High Priest,
Offered His blood, and died;
My guilty conscience seeks
No sacrifice beside:
His powerful blood did once atone,
And now it pleads before the throne.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
My Saviour and my Lord,
My Conqueror and my King,
Thy sceptre and Thy sword,
Thy reigning grace I sing:
Thine is the power; behold, I sit
In willing bonds beneath Thy feet.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
Now let my soul arise,
And tread the tempter down:
My Captain leads me forth
To conquest and a crown.
March on, nor fear to win the day,
Though death and hell obstruct the way.

verses.name: v6
verses.text:
Should all the hosts of death,
And powers of hell unknown,
Put their most dreadful forms
Of rage and malice on,
I shall be safe; for Christ displays
Superior power and guardian grace.

file: Just as I am (Charlotte Elliot).xml
title: Just as I am

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Just as I am, without one plea
But that Thy blood was shed for me,
And that Thou bid’st me come to Thee,
O Lamb of God, I come.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Just as I am, and waiting not
To rid my soul of one dark blot,
To Thee, whose blood can cleanse each spot,
O Lamb of God, I come.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Just as I am, though tossed about
With many a conflict, many a doubt,
Fightings and fears within, without,
O Lamb of God, I come.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Just as I am, poor, wretched, blind;
Sight, riches, healing of the mind,
Yea, all I need in Thee to find,
O Lamb of God, I come.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
Just as I am, Thou wilt receive,
Wilt welcome, pardon, cleanse, relieve,
Because Thy promise I believe,
O Lamb of God, I come.

verses.name: v6
verses.text:
Just as I am, Thy love unknown
Has broken every barrier down;
Now to be Thine, yea, Thine alone,
O Lamb of God, I come.

verses.name: v7
verses.text:
Just as I am, of that free love
The breadth, length, depth and height to prove,
Here for a season, then above,
O Lamb of God, I come.

file: KAMI_Y BUHAYIN (Tagalog Hymn).xml
title: KAMI'Y BUHAYIN

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Purihin ang Dios at Anak na Bugtong,
Namatay at sa langit S'ya ay humantong.

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
Aleluya, lwalhatiin! Aleluya, Amen;
Aleluya lwalhatiin! Kami'y buhayin.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Purihin ang Dios na lumiliwanag
Sa kadiliman, si Hesus inihayag

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Puri't l'walhati sa Kordero ng Dios
Sa sala'y nagligtas, luminis nang lubos

file: Kami_y Buhayin (Tagalog Hymn)-1.xml
title: Kami'y Buhayin

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Purihin ang Dios at Anak na Bugtong,
Namatay at sa langit S'ya ay humantong.

verses.name: c1a
verses.text:
Aleluya, lwalhatiin! Aleluya, Amen;
Aleluya lwalhatiin! Kami'y buhayin.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Purihin ang Dios na lumiliwanag
Sa kadiliman, si Hesus inihayag

verses.name: c1b
verses.text:
Aleluya, lwalhatiin! Aleluya, Amen;
Aleluya lwalhatiin! Kami'y buhayin.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Puri't l'walhati sa Kordero ng Dios
Sa sala'y nagligtas, luminis nang lubos

verses.name: c1c
verses.text:
Aleluya, lwalhatiin! Aleluya, Amen;
Aleluya lwalhatiin! Kami'y buhayin.

file: Kordero_y Putungan (Matthew Bridges).xml
title: Kordero'y Putungan

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Kordero’y putungan sa kanyang luklukan 
Ang himig ng kalangitan ang napapakingan
Kalul’wa, awitan, S’ya’ng nagbigay-buhay
Ngayo’t magpakaylan pa man, Hari’y bigyang pugay.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Ang Hari ng Buhay ,Ngayon ay putungan 
Sa laban at libingan, S’ya ay nagtagumpay.
Ang kal’walhatian ay ating isaysay
Tayo’y pinagkalooban walang hanggang buhay.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Hari ng Pag-ibig, ating parangalan 
Mga kamay N’ya’t tagiliran, Sa’ti’y nasugatan.
Mga angheles man di kayang pagmasdan
Panginoo’t Manlilikha na nagpakababa.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Putungan ang Hari ng kapayapaan 
Sa kanyang kapangyarihan walang kaguluhan
Ang paghahari n’ya’y magpawalang hanggan
Ng panalangi’t papuri, S’ya’y ating handugan.

file: Kung Tayo_y Mamuhay (Tagalog Hymn).xml
title: Kung Tayo'y Mamuhay

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Kung tayoy mamuhay, ayon sa patnubay
Ng Diyos at ng Kanyang Salita,
Sya'y sasa atin, kung atin S'yang sundin,
At kung tayo'y magtitiwala.

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
Magtiwala't si Hesus ay sundin,
Ang Kanyang kagalkan, laging sasaating

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Papawiin N'ya ang lahat ng pangamba,
Kung tayo'y laging mananangan;
Ang Kanyang patnubay, lagi nating taglay,
Sa daan tayo'y iingatan.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Kung ang ating buhay, sa Kanya'y ialay,
Ang pag-ibig N'ya ay kakamtan;
Ang bawat biyaya, at lahat ng awa
Ay sasaating palagian.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Kay tamis manalig, sa Kanyang pag-ibig,
Kung S'ya ay ating sinusunod;
At kahit na kaylan, tayo ay tawagan,
Buong puso tayong maglingkod.

file: Lahat ng mga Nilalang (Tagalog Hymn).xml
title: Lahat ng mga Nilalang

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Lahat ng mga nilalang
Ang Dios ay ating awitan
Aleluya! Aleluya!
O araw na maliwanag
O b'wan kay ganda ng sinag!

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
S'ya'y purihin; l'walhatiin
Aleluya! Aleluya! Aleluya!

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
O hangin na umiihip
At mga ulap sa langit
Purijin S'ya! Aleluya!
O umagang dumarating
Ikaw gabing sakdal dilim

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Lahat ng sangkatauhan 
Tayo'y mangagpatawaran
S'ya'y awitan, "Aleluya!"
Kayong mga nagdurusa
Hirap n'yo'y ipasakanya.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Lahat ng Kanyang nilikha
Sa Dios ay mangayupapa
Aleluya! Aleluya!
O papurihan natin S'ya
Ang Dios na tatlong persona.

file: Lead us Heavenly Father (James Edmeston).xml
title: Lead us Heavenly Father

verses.name: v1
v2
v3
verses.text:
Spirit of our God, descending,
Fill our hearts with heavenly joy,
Love with every passion blending,
Pleasure that can never cloy;
Thus provided, pardoned, guided,
Nothing can our peace destroy.

file: Let All the World (George Herbert).xml
title: Let All the World

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Let all the world in every corner sing:
‘My God and King!’
The heavens are not too high;
His praise may thither fly:
The earth is not too low;
His praises there may grow.
Let all the world in every corner sing:
‘My God and King!’

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Let all the world in every corner sing:
‘My God and King!’
The Church with psalms must shout,
No door can keep them out:
