But, above all, the heart
Must bear the longest part.
Let all the world in every corner sing:
‘My God and King!’

file: Let us Break Bread Together (Author Unknown).xml
title: Let us Break Bread Together

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Let us break bread together, we are one.
Let us break bread together, we are one.
We are one as we stand
With our face to the risen Son.
O Lord, have mercy on us.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Let us drink wine together, we are one.
Let us drink wine together, we are one.
We are one as we stand
With our face to the risen Son.
O Lord, have mercy on us

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Let us praise God together, we are one.
Let us praise God together, we are one.
We are one as we stand
With our face to the risen Son.
O Lord, have mercy on us

file: Let us With a Gladsome Mind (John Milton).xml
title: Let us With a Gladsome Mind

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Let us with a gladsome mind
Praise the Lord, for He is kind:

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
For His mercies shall endure,
Ever faithful, ever sure.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Let us blaze His name abroad,
For of gods He is the God:

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
He, with all-commanding might,
Filled the new-made world with light:

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
He the golden-tressed sun
Caused all day his course to run:

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
And the silver moon by night,
’Mid her spangled sisters bright:

verses.name: v6
verses.text:
He His chosen race did bless
In the wasteful wilderness:

verses.name: v7
verses.text:
All things living He doth feed,
His full hand supplies their need:

file: Like a River Glorious (Frances Ridley Havergal).xml
title: Like a River Glorious

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Like a river glorious is God’s perfect peace,
Over all victorious, in its bright increase:
Perfect, yet it floweth fuller every day;
Perfect, yet it groweth deeper all the way.

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
Stayed upon Jehovah, hearts are fully blest;
Finding, as He promised, perfect peace and rest.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Hidden in the hollow of His blessed hand,
Never foe can follow, never traitor stand;
Not a surge of worry, not a shade of care,
Not a blast of hurry touched the Spirit there.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Every joy or trial falleth from above,
Traced upon our dial by the sun of love.
We may trust Him fully, all for us to do;
They who trust Him wholly find Him wholly true.

file: Lo He Come With Clouds Descending (Charles Wesley).xml
title: Lo He Come With Clouds Descending

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Lo, He comes with coulds descending,
Once for favoured sinners slain;
Thousand thousand saints attending
Swell the triumph of His train:
Alleluia!
Alleluia!
Alleluia!
God appears on earth to reign.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Every eye shall now behold Him
Robed in glorious majesty;
Those who set at naught and sold Him,
Pierced and nailed Him to the tree,
Deeply wailing,
Deeply wailing,
Deeply wailing,
Shall their true Messiah see.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Those dear tokens of His passion
Still His dazzling body bears;
Cause of endless exultation
To His ransomed worshippers:
With what rapture,
With what rapture,
With what rapture,
Gaze we on those glorious scars.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Yea, Amen, let all adore Thee,
High on Thine eternal throne;
Saviour, take the power and glory,
Claim the kingdom for Thine own:
Come, Lord Jesus!
Come, Lord Jesus!
Come, Lord Jesus!
Everlasting God, come down!

file: Look Ye Saints The Sight is Glorious (Thomas Kelly).xml
title: Look Ye Saints The Sight is Glorious

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Look, ye saints, the sight is glorious;
See the Man of Sorrows now,
From the fight returned victorious;
Every knee to Him shall bow:
Crown Him! Crown Him!
Crown Him! Crown Him!
Crowns become the Victor’s brow.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Crown the Saviour, angels, crown Him;
Rich the trophies Jesus brings;
In the seat of power enthrone Him,
While the vault of heaven rings:
Crown Him! Crown Him!
Crown Him! Crown Him!
Crown the Saviour, King of kings!

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Sinners in derision crowned Him,
Mocking thus the Saviour’s claim;
Saints and angels throng around Him,
Own His title, praise His name:
Crown Him! Crown Him!
Crown Him! Crown Him!
Spread abroad the Victor’s fame.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Hark, those bursts of acclamation!
Hark, those loud triumphant chords!
Jesus takes the highest station:
O what joy the sight affords!
Crown Him! Crown Him!
Crown Him! Crown Him!
King of kings, and Lord of lords!

file: Lord Enthroned in Heavenly Splendour (G. H. Bourne).xml
title: Lord Enthroned in Heavenly Splendour

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Lord, enthroned in heavenly splendour,
First-begotten from the dead,
Thou alone, our strong Defender,
Liftest up Thy people’s head.
Alleluia! Alleluia!
Jesus, true and living Bread.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Here our humblest homage pay we,
Here in loving reverence bow;
Here for faith’s discernment pray we,
Lest we fail to know Thee now.
Alleluia! Alleluia!
Thou art here, we ask not how.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Though the lowliest form doth veil Thee
As of old in Bethlehem,
Here as there Thine angels hail Thee
Branch and Flower of Jesse’s stem.
Alleluia! Alleluia!
We in worship join with them.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Paschal Lamb, Thine offering, finished
Once for all when Thou wast slain,
In its fulness undiminished
Shall forever more remain,
Alleluia! Alleluia!
Cleansing souls from every stain.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
Life-imparting, heavenly Manna,
Stricken Rock with streaming side,
Heaven and earth with loud hosanna
Worship Thee, the Lamb who died,
Alleluia! Alleluia!
Risen, ascended, glorified!

file: Love Came Down at Christmas (Christina G. Rosetti).xml
title: Love Came Down at Christmas

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Love came down at Christmas,
Love all lovely, Love divine;
Love was born at Christmas,
Star and angels gave the sign.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Worship we the Godhead,
Love Incarnate, Love divine;
Worship we our Jesus:
But wherewith for sacred sign?

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Love shall be our token,
Love be yours and love be mine,
Love to God and all men,
Love for plea and gift and sign.

file: Love Divine (Charles Wesley).xml
title: Love Divine

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Love divine, all loves excelling,
Joy of heaven to earth come down!
Fix in us Thy humble dwelling,
All Thy faithful mercies crown.
Jesus, Thou art all compassion,
Pure unbounded love Thou art;
Visit us with Thy salvation,
Enter every trembling heart.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Breathe, O breathe Thy loving Spirit
Into every troubled breast!
Let us all in Thee inherit,
Let us find Thy promised rest.
Take away the love of sinning;
Alpha and Omega be;
End of faith, as its beginning,
Set our hearts at liberty.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Come, Almighty to deliver,
Let us all Thy grace receive;
Suddenly return, and never,
Never more Thy temples leave.
Thee we would be always blessing,
Serve Thee as Thy hosts above,
Pray, and praise Thee without ceasing,
Glory in Thy perfect love.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Finish then Thy new creation,
Pure and spotless let us be;
Let us see Thy great salvation
Perfectly restored in Thee!
Changed from glory into glory,
Till in heaven we take our place;
Till we cast our crowns before Thee,
Lost in wonder, love and praise.

file: Low in The Grave He Lay (Roberty Lowry).xml
title: Low in The Grave He Lay

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Low in the grave he lay,
Jesus, my Saviour,
Waiting the coming day,
Jesus, my Lord:

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
Up from the grave He arose,
With a mighty triumph o’er His foes;
He arose a Victor from the dark domain,
And He lives for ever with His saints to reign:
He arose! He arose!
Alleluia! Christ arose!

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Vainly they watch His bed,
Jesus, my Saviour;
Vainly they seal the dead,
Jesus, my Lord:

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Death cannot keep his prey,
Jesus, my Saviour;
He tore the bars away,
Jesus, my Lord:

file: Make Me A Channel of Blessings (Harper G. Smyth).xml
title: Make Me A Channel of Blessings

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Is your life a channel of blessing?
Is the love of God  flowing thru you?
Are you telling the Lost of the Savior?
Are you ready His service to do?

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
Make me a channel of blessing today,
Make me a channel of blessing, I pray;
My life possessing, my service blessing,
Make me a channel of blessing today.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Is your life a channel of blessing?
Are you burdened for those that are lost?
Have you urged upon those who are straying
The Savior who died on the cross?

verses.name: c2
verses.text:
Make me a channel of blessing today,
Make me a channel of blessing, I pray;
My life possessing, my service blessing,
Make me a channel of blessing today.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Is your life a channel of blessing?
Is it daily telling for Him?
Have you spoken the word of the Salvation
To those who are dying sin?

verses.name: c3
verses.text:
Make me a channel of blessing today,
Make me a channel of blessing, I pray;
My life possessing, my service blessing,
Make me a channel of blessing today.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
We cannot be channels of blessing?
If our lives are not free from known sin;
We will barriers be and a hindrance
To those we are trying to win.

verses.name: c4
verses.text:
Make me a channel of blessing today,
Make me a channel of blessing, I pray;
My life possessing, my service blessing,
Make me a channel of blessing today.

file: Man of Sorrows (Philipp Bliss).xml
title: Man of Sorrows

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Man of sorrows! what a name
For the Son of God, who came
Ruined sinners to reclaim!
Hallelujah! what a Saviour!

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Bearing shame and scoffing rude,
In my place condemned He stood;
Sealed my pardon with His blood:
Hallelujah! what a Saviour!

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Guilty, vile, and helpless, we;
Spotless Lamb of God was He:
Full atonement—can it be?
Hallelujah! what a Saviour!

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Lifted up was He to die,
‘It is finished!’ was His cry:
Now in heaven exalted high:
Hallelujah! what a Saviour!

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
When He comes, our glorious King,
All His ransomed home to bring,
Then anew this song we’ll sing:
‘Hallelujah! what a Saviour!’

file: Master Speak Thy Servant Heareth (Frances Ridley Havergal).xml
title: Master Speak Thy Servant Heareth

verses.name: v1
v2
verses.text:
Speak to me by name, O Master,
Let me know it is to me;
Speak, that I may follow faster,
With a step more firm and free,
Where the Shepherd leads the flock
In the shadow of the rock.

verses.name: v3
v4
verses.text:
Master, speak! and make me ready,
When Thy voice is truly heard,
With obedience glad and steady
Still to follow every word.
I am listening, Lord, for Thee;
Master, speak! O speak to me!

file: May the Mind of Christ my Saviour (Kate B. Wilkinson).xml
title: May the Mind of Christ my Saviour

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
May the mind of Christ my Saviour
Live in me from day to day,
By His love and power controlling
All I do and say.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
May the word  of God dwell richly
In my heart from hour to hour,
So that all may see I triumph
Only through His power.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
May the peace of God my Father
Rule my life in everything,
That I may be calm to comfort
Sick and sorrowing.
   
May the love of Jesus fill me,
As the waters fill the sea;
Him exalting, self abasing,
This is victory.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
May I run the race before me,
Strong and brave to face the foe,
Looking only unto Jesus,
As I onward go.

file: Mukti Dilaye (Author Unknown).xml
title: Mukti Dilaye

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Mukri dilaye Yesu naam,
Shanti dilaye Yesu naam.
(Repeat)
(Peace comes to you in Jesus’ name,
Salvation in no other name.)

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Yesu daya ka behta sagar
Yesu daya ka behta sagar
Yesu hai data mahan
Yesu hai data mahan
(Jesus is the Ocean of Grace:
You are majestic, Lord.)

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Charni main tooney janamliya Yesu
Charni main tooney janamliya Yesu
Sooley pay kiya vishram
Sooley pay kiya vishram
(Jesus, You were born in a manger (Made of wood:)
You were crucified on the cross (Made of wood.))

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Peace comes to you in Jesus’ name,
Salvation in no other name.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
Ham sab key papon ko mitane
Ham sab key papon ko mitane
Yesu hua hai balidan
Yesu hua hai balidan
(For the remission of our sins,
Jesus has been sacrificed on the cross.)

verses.name: v6
verses.text:
Krus par apna khoon bahaa kar
Krus par apna khoon bahaa kar
Sara chukaya daam
Sara chukaya daam
(By shedding Your blood on the cross,
You paid the full price for our sins.)

file: My God How Wonderful Thou Art (Frederick W. Faber).xml
title: My God How Wonderful Thou Art

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
My God, how wonderful Thou art,
Thy majesty how bright!
How beautiful Thy mercy-seat,
In depths of burning light!

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
How dread are Thine eternal years,
O everlasting Lord,
By prostrate spirits day and night
Incessantly adored!

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
How wonderful, how beautiful
The sight of Thee must be,
Thine endless wisdom, boundless power,
And awesome purity!

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
O how I fear Thee, living God,
With deepest, tenderest fears,
And worship Thee with trembling hope
And penitential tears!

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
Yet I may love Thee too, O Lord,
Almighty as Thou art,
For Thou hast stooped to ask of me
The love of my poor heart.

verses.name: v6
verses.text:
No earthly father loves like Thee;
No mother e’er so mild
Bears and forbears as Thou hast done
With me, Thy sinful child.

verses.name: v7
verses.text:
Father of Jesus, love’s reward,
What rapture will it be
Prostrate before Thy throne to lie,
And gaze, and gaze on Thee.

file: My Song is Love Unkown (Samuel Crossman).xml
title: My Song is Love Unkown

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
My song is love unknown,
My Saviour’s love to me: 
Love to the loveless shown, 
That they might lovely be. 
O who am I, that for my sake 
My Lord should take frail flesh and die?

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
He came from His blessed throne,
Salvation to bestow; 
But men made strange, and none 
The longed-for Christ would know: 
But O! my Friend, my Friend indeed, 
Who at my need His life did spend.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Sometimes they strew His way, 
And His sweet praises sing; 
Resounding all the day 
Hosannas to their King: 
Then ‘Crucify!’ is all their breath, 
And for His death they thirst and cry.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
They rise and needs will have 
My dear Lord made away; 
A murderer they save, 
The Prince of life they slay, 
Yet cheerful He to suffering goes, 
That He His foes from thence might free.

verses.name: v5
v6
verses.text:
Here might I stay and sing, 
No story so divine; 
Never was love, dear King! 
Never was grief like Thine. 
This is my Friend, in whose sweet praise 
I all my days could gladly spend.

file: Narinig Ko ang Sigaw (Tagalog Hymn).xml
title: Narinig Ko ang Sigaw

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Narinig ko ang sigaw;
 "S'ya ay nagliligtas!"
Ipangalat sa lahat,
 "S'ya ay nagliligtas!"
Sa lahat nang kinapal,
 Ang balita'y itanghal:
Humayo't ipangaral:
 S'ya ay nagliligtas!"

verses.name: v2
v3
verses.text:
Awitin sa labanan;
 "S'ya ay nagliligtas!"
Buhay N'ya'y inilaan:
 "S'ya ay nagliligtas!"
Puso ma'y naninimdim:
 Kaligtasa'y awitin
Libinga'y dadaigin;
 S'ya ay nagliligtas!

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Ating ipagsigawan:
 "S'ya ay nagliligtas!"
Ngayo'y magsipagdiwang;
 S'ya ay nagliligtas!
Ganap na kaligtasan
 At walang kabayaran
Tagumpay ay awitin;
 S'ya ay nagliligtas!"

file: Neare, My God, to Thee (Sarah F. Adams).xml
title: Neare, My God, to Thee

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Nearer my God, to Thee, Nearer to Thee!
E'en tho it be across That raiseth me;
Still all my song  shall be Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer, my God, to Thee, Nearer to Thee!

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Tho like a wanderer, the sun gone down,
Darkness be over me, My rest a stone,
Yet in my dreams I'd be Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer, my God, to Thee, Nearer to Thee!

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
There let the way appear, Steps unto heav'n;
All that Thou sendest me, In mercy giv'n
Angels to beckon me Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer, my God, to Thee, Nearer to Thee!

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Then with my walking thoughts, Bright with Thy praise,
Out of my stony griefs, Bethel I raise;
So by my woes to be Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer, my God, to Thee, Nearer to Thee!

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
Or if on joyful wing, Cleaving the sky,
Sun, moon and stars forgot, Upward I fly'
Still all my song shall be, Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer, my God, to Thee, Nearer to Thee!

file: Ngalang Hesus Papurihan (Tagalog Hymn).xml
title: Ngalang Hesus Papurihan

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Ngalang Hesus papurihan
Ating parangalan
Halina't S'ya ay putungan
Hari at Panginoon
Halina't S'ya ay putungan
Ating Hari't Panginoon.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Kayong mga hinirang N'ya
'Niligtas sa sala
Purihin ang kabutihan
Ng Hari't Panginoon
Purihin ang kabutihan
S'ya na Hari't Panginoon.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Bawat lahi, bawat angkan
Ngayo'y nagdiriwang
Dakilain, parangalan
Ang Hari't Panginoon
Dakilain, parangalan
S'ya na Hari't Panginoon.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Lahat ng mga hinirang
Do'n sa kalangitan
Pupurihin nating walang hanggan
Ang Hari't Panginoon
Pupurihin nating walang hanggan
Ating Hari't Panginoon.

file: Now Thank We All Our God (Martin Rinkart).xml
title: Now Thank We All Our God

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Now thank we all our God,
With hearts and hands and voices; 
Who wondrous things has done, 
In whom His world rejoices; 
Who from our mother’s arms 
Has blessed us on our way 
With countless gifts of love, 
And still is ours today.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
O may this bounteous God 
Through all our life be near us, 
With ever joyful hearts 
And blessed peace to cheer us; 
And keep us in His grace, 
And guide us when perplexed, 
And free us from all ills 
In this world and the next.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
All praise and thanks to God 
The Father now be given, 
The Son, and Him who reigns 
With them in highest heaven, 
The one eternal God, 
Whom earth and heaven adore; 
For thus it was, is now, 
And shall be ever more.

file: O Breath of God Breathe on us Now (Alfred Vine).xml
title: O Breath of God Breathe on us Now

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
O breath of God, breathe on us now,
And move within us while we pray;
The Spring of our new life art Thou,
The very light of our new day.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
O strangely art Thou with us, Lord,
Neither in height nor depth to seek:
In nearness shall Thy voice be heard;
Spirit to spirit Thou dost speak.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Christ is our Advocate on high;
Thou art our Advocate within.
O plead the truth, and make reply
To every argument of sin.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
But ah, this faithless heart of mine,
The way I know, I know my Guide;
Forgive me, O my Friend divine,
That I so often turn aside.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
Be with me when no other friend
The mystery of my heart can share;
And be Thou known, when fears transcend,
By Thy best name of Comforter.

file: O Breath of Life Come Sweeping Through (Elizabeth Porter Head).xml
title: O Breath of Life Come Sweeping Through

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
O breath of life, come sweeping through us,
Revive Thy church with life and power. 
O Breath of Life, come, cleanse, renew us, 
And fit Thy church to meet this hour.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
O Wind of God, come, bend us, break us, 
Till humbly we confess our need; 
Then in Thy tenderness remake us, 
Revive, restore; for this we plead.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
O Breath of Love, come, breathe within us,
Renewing thought and will and heart: 
Come, love of Christ, afresh to win us, 
Revive Thy church in every part.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Revive us, Lord! is zeal abating 
While harvest fields are vast and white? 
Revive us, Lord, the world is waiting, 
Equip Thy church to spread the light.

file: O Come Let us Adore Him (Author Unknown).xml
title: O Come Let us Adore Him

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
O come let us adore Him,
O come let us adore Him, 
O come let us adore Him, 
Christ the Lord.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
For He alone is worthy,
For He alone is worthy,
For He alone is worthy,
Christ the Lord.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
We’ll give Him all the glory,
We’ll give Him all the glory,
We’ll give Him all the glory,
Christ the Lord.

file: O Come O Come Immanuel (John Mason Neale).xml
title: O Come O Come Immanuel

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
O come, O come, Immanuuel,
And ransom captive Israel, 
That mourns in lonely exile here 
Until the Son of God appear.

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
Rejoice, rejoice! Immanuel 
Shall come to thee, O Israel.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
O come, O come, Thou Lord of might 
Who to Thy tribes on Sinai’s height 
In ancient times didst give the law 
In cloud, and majesty, and awe.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
O come, Thou Rod of Jesse, free 
Thine own from Satan’s tyranny; 
From depths of hell Thy people save 
And give them victory o’er the grave.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
O come, Thou Dayspring, come and cheer 
Our spirits by Thine advent here; 
Disperse the gloomy clouds of night, 
And death’s dark shadows put to flight.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
O come, Thou Key of David, come 
And open wide our heavenly home; 
Make safe the way that leads on high, 
And close the path to misery.

file: O For a Closer Walk With God (William Cowper).xml
title: O For a Closer Walk With God

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
O for a closer walk with God,
A calm and heavenly frame,
A light to shine upon the road
That leads me to the Lamb.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Where is the blessedness I knew
When I first saw the Lord?
Where is that soul-refreshing view
Of Jesus and His word?

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
What peaceful hours I once enjoyed!
How sweet their memory still!
But they have left an aching void
The world can never fill.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Return, O holy Dove! return,
Sweet messenger of rest!
I hate the sins that made Thee mourn,
And drove Thee from my breast.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
The dearest idol I have known,
Whate’er that idol be,
Help me tear if from Thy throne,
And worship only Thee.

verses.name: v6
verses.text:
So shall my walk be close with God,
Calm and serene my frame;
So purer light shall mark the road
That leads me to the Lamb.

file: O For a Heart to Praise My God (Charles Wesley).xml
title: O For a Heart to Praise My God

verses.name: v1
v2
verses.text:
A heart resigned, submissive, meek, 
My great Redeemer’s throne, 
Where only Christ is heard to speak, 
Where Jesus reigns alone;

verses.name: v3
v4
verses.text:
A heart in every thought renewed, 
And full of love divine; 
Perfect and right, and pure, and good: 
A copy, Lord, of Thine.

verses.name: v5

file: O For a Thousand Tongues (Charles Wesley).xml
title: O For a Thousand Tongues

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
O for a thousand tongues to sing 
My great Redeemer’s praise, 
My great Redeemer’s praise! 
The glories of my God and King, 
The triumphs of His grace!

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Jesus! the name that charms our fears, 
That bids our sorrows cease, 
That bids our sorrows cease; 
’Tis music in the sinner’s ears, 
’Tis life, and health, and peace.

verses.name: v3
v4
verses.text:
He breaks the power of cancelled sin, 
He sets the prisoner free, 
He sets the prisoner free; 
His blood can make the foulest clean, 
His blood availed for me.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
He speaks and, listening to His voice, 
New life the dead receive, 
New life the dead receive; 
The mournful, broken hearts rejoice, 
The humble poor believe.

verses.name: v6
v7
verses.text:
My gracious Master and my God, 
Assist me to proclaim, 
Assist me to proclaim, 
To spread through all the earth abroad 
The honours of Thy name.

file: O God our Help in Ages Past (Isaac Watts).xml
title: O God our Help in Ages Past

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
O God, our help in ages past,
Our hope for years to come, 
Our shelter from the stormy blast, 
And our eternal home.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Under the shadow of Thy throne 
Thy saints have dwelt secure; 
Sufficient is Thine arm alone, 
And our defence is sure.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Before the hills in order stood, 
Or earth received her frame, 
From everlasting Thou art God, 
To endless years the same.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
A thousand ages in Thy sight 
Are like an evening gone, 
Short as the watch that ends the night 
Before the rising sun.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
Time, like an ever-rolling stream, 
Bears all its sons away; 
They fly forgotten, as a dream 
Dies at the opening day.
O God, our help in ages past, 
Our hope for years to come, 
Be Thou our guard while troubles last, 
And our eternal home.

file: O Hesus Iniaalay (Tagalog Hymn).xml
title: O Hesus Iniaalay

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
O Hessus, iniaalay ang lahat ko sa buhay
At iibigin kang tunay at pagtitiwalaan

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
Inaalay ko, Inaalay ko
Sa'yo ang lahat oh Kristo
Inaalay ko

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Ngayo'y Inilalapit ko Sa'Yo ang aking puso;
Ang samo'y papagkamtin Mo ng biyaya't saklolo

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Sa'Yo ay inihahandog ang wagas na pag-ibig;
ang pagpapala'y ibuhos sa aba't dukhang lingkod.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Pagkatapos kong matanggap ang mayamang Mo'ng lingap;
Gagawin kong buong sikap, ang dakila Mong atas.

file: O Hesus na aking Buhay (Tagalog Hymn).xml
title: O Hesus na aking Buhay

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
O, Hesus na aking buhay
Kaibigan kong tunay,
Ikaw andg aking patnubay
Sa mundo’y baking tanglaw.

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
O ako’y samahan
Sa landas ng buhay;
Puso ko’y may kasiyahan
Kung kasama ko’y Ikaw.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Di dangal o kayamanan
Ang nais kong makamtan;
Ang mithiin ko sa buhay
Ang ikaw’y paglingkuran.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Ang tanang kapighatian
At madling kahirapan
Ay matitiis kong tunay
Kung Karamay ko’y ikaw.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Hindi ko katatakutan
Kahit ang kamatayan,
Dahil ang pumapatnubay
Sa aki’y tanging Ikaw.

file: O Jesus I Have Promised (John Ernest Bode).xml
title: O Jesus I Have Promised

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
O Jesus, I have promised
To serve Thee to the end; 
Be Thou forever near me, 
My Master and my Friend; 
I shall not fear the battle 
If Thou art by my side, 
Nor wander from the pathway 
If Thou wilt be my Guide.

verses.name: v2
v3
verses.text:
O let me hear Thee speaking 
In accents clear and still, 
Above the storms of passion, 
The murmurs of self-will; 
O speak to reassure me, 
To hasten, or control; 
O speak, and make me listen, 
Thou Guardian of my soul.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
O Jesus, Thou hast promised 
To all who follow Thee 
That where Thou art in glory 
There shall Thy servants be; 
And, Jesus, I have promised 
To serve Thee to the end; 
O give me grace to follow 
My Master and my Friend.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
O let me see Thy footmarks, 
And in them plant mine own; 
My hope to follow duly 
Is in Thy strength alone. 
O guide me, call me, draw me, 
Uphold me to the end; 
And then in heaven receive me, 
My Saviour and my Friend.

file: O Little Town of Bethlehem (Philips Brooks).xml
title: O Little Town of Bethlehem

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
O little town of Bethlehem,
How still we see thee lie! 
Above thy deep and dreamless sleep 
The silent stars go by. 
Yet in thy dark streets shineth 
The everlasting Light; 
The hopes and fears of all the years 
Are met in thee tonight.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
O morning stars, together
Proclaim the holy birth,
And praises sing to God the King,
And peace to men on earth;
For Christ is born of Mary,
And gathered all above,
While mortals sleep, the angels keep
Their watch of wondering love.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
How silently, how silently
The wondrous gift is given! 
So God imparts to human hearts 
The blessings of His heaven. 
No ear may hear His coming; 
But in this world of sin, 
Where meek souls will receive Him, still 
The dear Christ enters in.

verses.name: v4

file: O Love That Wilt Not Let Me Go (George Matheson).xml
title: O Love That Wilt Not Let Me Go

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
O love that wilt not let me go,
I rest my weary soul in thee: 
I give thee back the life I owe, 
That in thine ocean depths its flow
May richer, fuller be.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
O light that followest all my way,
I yield my flickering torch to thee: 
My heart restores its borrowed ray,
That in thy sunshine’s blaze its day
May brighter, fairer be.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
O joy that seekest me through pain,
I cannot close my heart to thee:
I trace the rainbow through the rain,
And feel the promise is not vain,
That morn shall tearless be.
O cross that liftest up my head,
I dare not ask to fly from thee:
I lay in dust life’s glory dead,
And from the ground there blossoms red
Life that shall endless be.

file: O Praise Ye The Lord (Henry W. Baker).xml
title: O Praise Ye The Lord

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
O praise ye the Lord!
Praise Him in the height; 
Rejoice in His word, 
Ye angels of light; 
Ye heavens adore Him 
By whom ye were made, 
And worship before Him
In brightness arrayed.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
O praise ye the Lord! 
Praise Him upon earth, 
In tuneful accord, 
Ye sons of new birth; 
Praise Him who hath brought you 
His grace from above, 
Praise Him who hath taught you 
To sing of His love.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
O praise ye the Lord, 
All things that give sound; 
Each jubilant chord, 
Re-echo around: 
Loud organs, His glory 
Forthtell in deep tone, 
And sweet harp, the story 
Of what He hath done.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
O praise ye the Lord! 
Thanksgiving and song 
To Him be outpoured 
All ages along; 
For love in creation, 
For heaven restored, 
For grace of salvation, 
O praise ye the Lord!

file: O Sacred Head Once Wounded (Paulus Gerhardt).xml
title: O Sacred Head Once Wounded

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
O sacred head, once wounded,
With grief and pain weighed down, 
How scornfully surrounded 
With thorns, Thine only crown! 
How pale art Thou with anguish, 
With sore abuse and scorn! 
How does that visage languish, 
Which once was bright as morn!

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
O Lord of life and glory, 
What bliss till now was Thine! 
I read the wondrous story, 
I joy to call Thee mine. 
Thy grief and Thy compassion 
Were all for sinners’ gain; 
Mine, mine was the transgression, 
But Thine the deadly pain.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
What language shall I borrow
To praise Thee, heavenly Friend,
For this, Thy dying sorrow,
Thy pity without end?
Lord, make me Thine for ever,
Nor let me faithless prove;
O let me never, never
Abuse such dying love!

verses.name: v4

file: O Saviour Lifted (W. W. How).xml
title: O Saviour Lifted

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
O my Saviour, lifted
From the earth for me, 
Draw me, in Thy mercy, 
Nearer unto Thee.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Lift my earthbound longings, 
Fix them, Lord, above; 
Draw me with the magnet 
Of Thy mighty love.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
And I come, Lord Jesus; 
Dare I turn away? 
No! Thy love hath conquered, 
And I come today.
Bringing all my burdens,
Sorrow, sin, and care;
At Thy feet I lay them,
And I leave them there.

file: O Thou Who Camest From Above (Charles Wesley).xml
title: O Thou Who Camest From Above

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
O Thou who camest from above
The pure celestial fire to impart, 
Kindle a flame of sacred love 
On the mean altar of my heart.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
There let it for Thy glory burn 
With inextinguishable blaze, 
And trembling to its source return, 
In humble prayer and fervent praise.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Jesus, confirm my heart’s desire 
To work, and speak, and think for Thee; 
Still let me guard the holy fire, 
And still stir up Thy gift in me.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Ready for all Thy perfect will, 
My acts of faith and love repeat, 
Till death Thy endless mercies seal, 
And make the sacrifice complete.

file: O Worship the Lord (John S. B. Monsell).xml
title: O Worship the Lord

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
O worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness,
Bow down before Him, His glory proclaim;
With gold of obedience and incense of lowliness,
Kneel and adore Him; the Lord is His name.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Low at His feet lay thy burden of carefulness, 
High on His heart He will bear it for thee, 
Comfort thy sorrows, and answer thy prayerfulness, 
Guiding thy steps as may best for thee be.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Fear not to enter His courts in the slenderness 
Of the poor wealth thou wouldst reckon as thine; 
Truth in its beauty, and love in its tenderness, 
These are the offerings to lay on His shrine.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
These, though we bring them in trembling and fearfulness,
He will accept for the name that is dear;
Mornings of joy give for evenings of tearfulness,
Trust for our trembling, and hope for our fear.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
O worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness, 
Bow down before Him, His glory proclaim; 
With gold of obedience and incense of lowliness, 
Kneel and adore Him: the Lord is His name.

file: Once In Royal David_s City (Cecil F. Alexander).xml
title: Once In Royal David's City

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Once in royal David's city,
Stood a lowly cattle shed, 
Where a mother laid her baby
In a manger for His bed. 
Mary was that mother mild, 
Jesus Christ, her little child.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
He came down to earth from heaven, 
Who is God and Lord of all, 
And His shelter was a stable, 
And His cradle was a stall: 
With the poor and meek and lowly 
Lived on earth our Saviour holy.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
And through all His wondrous childhood 
He would honour and obey, 
Love and watch the lowly mother 
In whose gentle arms He lay. 
Christian children all should be 
Mild, obedient, good as He.

verses.name: v4
v5
v6
verses.text:
Not in that poor lowly stable, 
With the oxen standing by, 
We shall see Him, but in heaven, 
Set at God’s right hand on high; 
When like stars His children crowned, 
All in white shall wait around.

file: PANGINOON PAG AKING BINUBULAY (Tagalog Hymn).xml
title: PANGINOON PAG AKING BINUBULAY

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Panginoon, pag aking binubulay
Ang kalakhan ng ‘Yong sangnilikha
Sa bituin, sa kulog na maingay
Kapangyarihan Mo’y nakikita.

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
Umaawit yaring kaluluwa
“Dakila ka, aking Ama”
Pinupuri Kita’t sinasamba
Dios ko’t Ama, dakila ka!

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Sa gitna ng bukid at kagubatan
Mga ibon ay napapakinggan
At sa tuktok ng mga kabundukan
Simoy ng hangi’y nararamdaman.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
‘Di ko lubusang nauunawaan
Dios binigay ang Bugtong N’ya’ng anak
At sala ko sa krus ay binayaran
Upang ako’y’ di na mapahamak.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Pagbalik N’ya, ako’y kanyang kukunin
Ano’ng galak ang mararamdaman
At sa langit ikaw ay pupurihan
Itatanghal ‘Yong kal’walhatian.

file: Panginoon, Puso Ko_y Suriin (Tagalog Hymn).xml
title: Panginoon, Puso Ko'y Suriin

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Panginoon, puso ko'y suriin
Laman ng isip ay 'Yong alamin
Tuklasin Mo kung may salang lihim
Kaluluwa ko ay 'Yong linisin.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Pinupiri Kita, Panginoon
Sa kasalanan kong hinugasan
Puspusin mo ng 'Yong kabanalan
Dadakilain ko 'Yong Pangalan.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Ang buhay ko ngayon ay tanggapin
Ng pag-ibig Mo ako'y punuin
Sariling kalooba't damdamin
Angkinin Mo't manahan Ka sa'kin

file: Peace Is Flowing Like a River (Author Unknown).xml
title: Peace Is Flowing Like a River

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Peace is flowing like a river,
Flowing out through you and me, 
Spreading out into the desert, 
Setting all the captives free.

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
Let it flow through me, 
Let it flow through me, 
Let the mighty peace of God 
Flow out through me. 
Let it flow through me, 
Let it flow through me, 
Let the mighty peace of God 
Flow out through me.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Love is flowing like a river,
Flowing out through you and me, 
Spreading out into the desert, 
Setting all the captives free.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Joy is flowing like a river,
Flowing out through you and me, 
Spreading out into the desert, 
Setting all the captives free.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Faith is flowing like a river,
Flowing out through you and me, 
Spreading out into the desert, 
Setting all the captives free.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
Hope is flowing  like a river,
Flowing out through you and me, 
Spreading out into the desert, 
Setting all the captives free.

file: Peace Perfect Peace (E. H. Bickersteth).xml
title: Peace Perfect Peace

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Peace, perfect peace, in this dark world of sin?
The blood of Jesus whispers peace within.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Peace, perfect peace, by thronging duties pressed?
To do the will of Jesus, this is rest.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Peace, perfect peace, with sorrows surging round?
In Jesus’ presence nought but calm is found.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Peace, perfect peace, with loved ones far away?
In Jesus’ keeping we are safe, and they.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
Peace, perfect peace, our future all unknown?
Jesus we know, and He is on the throne.

verses.name: v6
verses.text:
Peace, perfect peace, death shadowing us and ours?
Jesus has vanquished death and all its powers.

verses.name: v7
verses.text:
It is enough: earth’s struggles soon shall cease,
And Jesus calls us to heaven’s perfect peace.

file: Praise My Soul King of Heaven (Henry Francis Lyte).xml
title: Praise My Soul King of Heaven

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Praise, my soul, the King of heaven;
To His feet thy tribute bring. 
Ransomed, healed, restored, forgiven, 
Who like thee His praise should sing? 
Praise Him! Praise Him! 
Praise Him! Praise Him! 
Praise the everlasting King!

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Praise Him for His grace and favour 
To our fathers in distress; 
Praise Him, still the same forever, 
Slow to chide, and swift to bless. 
Praise Him! Praise Him! 
Praise Him! Praise Him! 
Glorious in His faithfulness.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Father-like, He tends and spares us; 
Well our feeble frame He knows; 
In His hands He gently bears us, 
Rescues us from all our foes. 
Praise Him! Praise Him! 
Praise Him! Praise Him! 
Widely as His mercy flows.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Angels in the height, adore Him; 
Ye behold Him face to face; 
Sun and moon, bow down before Him, 
Dwellers all in time and space. 
Praise Him! Praise Him! 
Praise Him! Praise Him! 
Praise with us the God of grace!

file: Praise the Lord The Almighty (Joachim Neander).xml
title: Praise the Lord The Almighty

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Praise to the Lord, the Almighty, the King of creation!
O my soul, praise Him, for He is thy health and salvation!
All ye who hear, now to His temple draw near
Join me in glad adoration!

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Praise to the Lord, who o'er all things so wondrously reighneth
Shall thirst thee under His wings yea so gently sustaineth!
Hast thou not seen how thy desires e'er have been
Granted in what He ordaineth?

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Praise to the Lord, who with marvelous wisdom hath made thee!
Decked thee with health, and with loving hand guided and stayed thee;
How oft in grief hath not he brought thee relief,
Spreading His wings for to shade thee!

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Praise to the Lord! O let all that is in me adore Him!
All that hath life and breath, come now with praises before Him!
Let the Amen sound from His people again:
Gladly for aye we adore Him.

file: Praise to the Holiest in the Height (John H. Newman).xml
title: Praise to the Holiest in the Height

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Praise to the holiest in the height,
And in the depth be praise; 
In all His words most wonderful, 
Most sure in all His ways.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
O loving wisdom of our God! 
When all was sin and shame, 
A second Adam to the fight 
And to the rescue came.
O wisest love! that flesh and blood, 
Which did in Adam fail, 
Should strive afresh against the foe, 
Should strive and should prevail;

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
And that a higher gift than grace 
Should flesh and blood refine,
God’s presence and His very self, 
And essence all-divine.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
O generous love! that He, who smote 
In Man for man the foe, 
The double agony in Man 
For man should undergo;

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
And in the garden secretly, 
And on the cross on high, 
Should teach His brethren, and inspire 
To suffer and to die.

verses.name: v6
verses.text:
Praise to the Holiest in the height,
And to the depth be praise;
In all His words most wonderful,
Most sure in all His ways.

file: Purihin ang Panginoon (Tagalog Hymn).xml
title: Purihin ang Panginoon

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Purihin ang Panginoong makapangyarihan
Kalul'wa ko, purihin S'ya sa 'yong kaligtasan
O halina't tayo ay magsisamba
At S'ya ay ating awitan.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Purihin S'ya na naghahari sa sangnilikha
Sa lilim ng bagwis N'ya tayo'y kinakalinga
Binigay N'ya'ng ating mga kailangan
Ayon sa kanyang kalooban.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Purihin S'ya'ng nagpapala sa ating gawain
Ang kabutihan N'ya'y palaging sumasaatin
Pag-isipan ang biyayang kakamtan
Kung tayo'y Kanyang kalugdan.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Purihin ang Panginoon,S'ya'y awitan natin
Halina't sama-sama natin S'ya'ng l'walhatiin
Pagpupugay ating ulit-ulitin
O S'ya ay sambahin natin.

file: Rejoice the Lord is King (Charles Wesley).xml
title: Rejoice the Lord is King

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Rejoice, the Lord is King!
Your Lord and King adore; 
Mortals, give thanks, and sing, 
And triumph ever more:

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
Lift up your heart, lift up your voice; 
Rejoice! Again I say: rejoice!

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Jesus the Saviour reigns, 
The God of truth and love;
When He had purged our stains, 
He took His seat above:

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
His kingdom cannot fail, 
He rules o’er earth and heaven; 
The keys of death and hell 
Are to our Jesus given:

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
He sits at God’s right hand 
Till all His foes submit, 
And bow to His command, 
And fall beneath His feet:

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
Rejoice in glorious hope; 
Jesus the Judge shall come, 
And take His servants up 
To their eternal home:

verses.name: e1
verses.text:
We soon shall hear the archangel’s voice;
The trump of God shall sound: rejoice!

file: Ride on Ride on in Majesty (H. H. Milman).xml
title: Ride on Ride on in Majesty

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Ride on, ride on in majesty!
In lowly pomp ride on to die! 
O Christ, Thy triumphs now begin 
O’er captive death and conquered sin.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Ride on, ride on in majesty! 
Hark all the tribes ‘hosanna’ cry; 
Thine humble beast pursues his road 
With palms and scattered garments strowed.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Ride on, ride on in majesty! 
Thy last and fiercest strife is nigh; 
The Father on His sapphire throne 
Expects His own anointed Son.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Ride on, ride on in majesty! 
In lowly pomp ride on to die! 
Bow Thy meek head to mortal pain, 
Then take, O God, Thy power, and reign!

file: SA DIOS ANG PAPURI (Tagalog Hymn).xml
title: SA DIOS ANG PAPURI

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Sa Dios ang papuri’t kal’walhatian
Dahil minamahal tayo ng lubusan
Sinugo si Hesus Anak N’yang bugtong
Upang kaligtasa’y ating makamtan.

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
Dios ay papurihan!
S’ya’y ating awitan!
Dios ay papurihan!
Tayo ay magdiwang!
Purihin ang Kanyang kadakilaan
Na kay Hesus ating nararanasan.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
O Kaligtasan sa dugo ni Hesus
Sa bawat manalig pangako ng Dios
Ang mananampalataya ng lubos
Patawad kakamtan sa Manunubos.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Dakila ang sa ti’y Kanyang ginawa
Kay Hesus tayo’y Kanyang pinagpala
Ngunit mas higit na kamanghamangha
Ang mukhaan natin S’yang makikita.

file: SA PAG-IBIG NI KRISTO (Tagalog Hymn).xml
title: SA PAG-IBIG NI KRISTO

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Sa pag-ibig ni Kristo,
Ako ay tinubos
Ang aking kasalana'y
Pinawi N'yang lubos
Kaya ang aking awit
Na di matapus-tapos
Ay "Purihin si Kristong
Aking Manunubos."

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
Tunay na di nagbabago
Ang pag-ibig ni Kristo;
Lalong tumitibay at laging dalisay
Ang Kanyang pagmamahal

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Bawat nayon at bayan
Sa lupaing banal
Ay dinalhan ni Kristo
Ng aral N'yang mahal;
Mga sakit at dusa
Ag Kanyang nilunasan,
At kinupkop ang taong 
Sa sala'y naligaw.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Dakila N'yang pag-ibig
Ang tanging dahilan
Tayong makasalana'y
Sinakop na tunay;
Kapag ating sapitin,
Langit na Kanyang bayan,
Atin S'yang pupurihin
Magpawalang hanggan.

file: SA PUSO KO’Y MAY TANGING AWIT (Tagalog Hymn).xml
title: SA PUSO KO’Y MAY TANGING AWIT

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Sa puso ko’y may tangin awit,
Na nagbuhat pa sa langit;
Walang kasing gandang himig
Ito nga ay ang pag-ibig.

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
Sa puso ko’y may isang awit,
Ng gaya ng nasa langit;
Sapuso ko’y may isang awit 
Na si Hesus ang pag-ibig.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Aking iniibig si Hesus,
Na namatay  doon sa Krus:
Sa  kasalanan ay tinubos
At kagaaka’y mapuspos.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Doon sa kaluwalhatian,
Ako ay maninirahan;
Kasaa ng anghel na tanan,
At ang buong kalangitan.

file: See Amid the Winter_s Snow (Edward Caswall).xml
title: See Amid the Winter's Snow

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
See, amid the winter's snow,
Born for us on earth below, 
See, the Lamb of God appears, 
Promised from eternal years.

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
Hail, thou ever-blessed morn! 
Hail, redemption’s happy dawn! 
Sing through all Jerusalem:
Christ is born in Bethlehem!

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Lo, within a manger lies
He who built the starry skies,
He who throned in height sublime
Sits amid the cherubim.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Say, ye holy shepherds, say, 
What your joyful news today; 
Wherefore have ye left your sheep 
On the lonely mountain steep?

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
‘As we watched at dead of night, 
Lo, we saw a wondrous light: 
Angels singing, “Peace on earth” 
Told us of the Saviour’s birth.’

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
Sacred Infant, all divine, 
What a tender love was Thine, 
Thus to come from highest bliss 
Down to such a world as this!

verses.name: v6
verses.text:
Teach, O teach us, holy Child, 
By Thy face so meek and mild, 
Teach us to resemble Thee 
In Thy sweet humility.

file: Set my Spirit Free (Author Unknown).xml
title: Set my Spirit Free

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Set my spirit free that I might worship Thee, 
Set my spirit free that I might praise Thy name. 
Let all bondage go and let deliverance flow, 
Set my spirit free to worship Thee.

file: Show Me Thy Way, O Lord (Alfred B. Smith).xml
title: Show Me Thy Way, O Lord

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Show me Thy way, O Lord And make it plain:
I would obey Thy word, Speak yet again.
I would not take one step until I know
Which way it is that you want me to go.

verses.name: v2
v3
verses.text:
I cannot see Thy face, Yet Thou art here;
When will the morning chase My doubt and fear?
When I shall I see the place where day and night
Shall come not, for Thy glory is its light?

verses.name: v4

file: Si Hesus Ang Siyang Patnubay (Fanny Crosby).xml
title: Si Hesus Ang Siyang Patnubay

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Si Hesus ang s’yang patnubay sa landas ng buhay ko
Hindi S’ya nagpapabaya laging sumasaklolo
Buhay ko ay mapayapa laging may kaaliwan
Dahil s’yay aking kasama’t di ako iniiwan
Dahil s’yay aking kasama’t di ako iniiwan.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Si Hesus ang s’yang patnubay S’yay laging nagmamasid
Sa aki’y kumakalinga S’ya’y lipos ng pag-ibig
Kahit na may kahirapan landasing tinatahak
Puso ko’y may kasiyahan at lagi nang may galak
Puso ko’y may kasiyahan at lagi nang may galak.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Si Hesus ang S’yang patnubay ang pag-ibig n’ya’y lubos
Ang biyaya N’ya’y sagana at hindi kinakapos.
Hanggang sa wakas ng buhay dito sa sanlibutan
S’ya’y lagi nang sasaakin at ako’y di iiwan
S’ya’y lagi nang sasaakin at ako’y di iiwan.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Si Hesus ang S’yang patnubay hanggang aking marating
Langit na Kanyang tahanan na lipos ng paggiliw
Pag ako’y kanyang tinawag at ipisan sa Ama
S’yay twina ang pupurihin doon sa walang hanggan
S’yay twina ang pupurihin doon sa walang hanggan.

file: Si Hesus ang Lahat Sa_kin (Tagalog Hymn).xml
title: Si Hesus ang Lahat Sa'kin

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Si Hesus ang lahat sa'kin
S'ya ang aking buhay
Lakas ko sya sa tuwina
Ako'y ligtas sa Kanya
Kung mayroong kalungkutan
S'ya ang aking kagalakan
Tunay ko S'yang kaibigan
Kaylanman.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Si Hesus ang lahat sa'kin
Karamay ko t'wina
Sa pagsubok man at tukso
Iniingatan ako 
Sikat ng araw at ulan
At masaganang ani man
Pagpapalang mula sa Dios
Ay sa'kin

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Si Hesus ang lahat sa'kin
Biyaya Nya'y sapat
P'nong ako'y manlalamig
S'yang sa ki'y laging tapat
Sa Kanya lamang susunod
Sa Kanya ay maglilingkod
Aking buhay iaalay
Kay Hesus.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Si Hesus ang lahat sa'kin
S'ya lang ang susundin
Buo ang aking tiwala
Sya'ng tangi kong pag-asa
Anong ligaya ng buhay
Kung si Kristo ang kaakbay
Walang hanggang kagalakan
Sa Kanya.

file: Soldiers of Christ Arise (Charles Wesley).xml
title: Soldiers of Christ Arise

verses.name: v1
v2
verses.text:
Strong in the Lord of hosts, 
And in His mighty power; 
Who in the strength of Jesus trusts 
Is more than conqueror.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Stand, then, in His great might,
With all His strength endued;
And take, to arm you for the fight,
The panoply of God.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Leave no unguarded place, 
No weakness of the soul; 
Take every virtue, every grace, 
And fortify the whole.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
From strength to strength go on, 
Wrestle and fight and pray; 
Tread all the powers of darkness down, 
And win the well-fought day.

verses.name: v6
verses.text:
That having all things done, 
And all your conflicts past, 
Ye may o’ercome, through Christ alone, 
And stand complete at last.

file: TANGING KAY KRISTO (Tagalog Hymn).xml
title: TANGING KAY KRISTO

verses.name: v1
c1
verses.text:
Hesus kong Mananakop 
Ako’y lyong tunay, 
Pagkat dahil sa akin 
Ikaw ay namatay. 
Kayat lkaw na lamang 
Ang paglalaanan 
Ng buong buhay ko, Hesus, Magpakaylan pa man.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Tanging kay Kristo ang kaligtasan,
Ang aking sala’y Kanyang pinasan;
Pagtawag N’ya ay aking pakinggan,
Ang mga yapak N’ya ay susundan.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Tanging si Kristo ang pupurihin
Sa bawa’t bagay na aking gawin;
Lahat ng hirap handang tiisin
Saan mang dako papupuntahin.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Tanging kay Kristo ko ibibigay
Hanggang matapos ang aking buhay,
Upang magamit sa pag-aakay
Ng mga kaluluwang nawalay.

file: Teach Me Thy Way, O Lord (Mansell Ramsey).xml
title: Teach Me Thy Way, O Lord

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Teach me Thy way, O Lord, Teach me Thy Way!
Thy guiding grace afford, Teach me Thy Way!
Help me to walk a right, more by faith, less by sight;
Lead me with heavn’ly light- Teach me Thy Way!

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
When I am sad at heart, Teach me Thy Way!
When earthly joys depart, Teach me Thy way!
In hours of loneliness, In times of dire distress,
In failure or success, Teach me Thy Way!

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
When doubts and fears arise, Teach me Thy Way!
When storms o’er spread the skies, Teach me Thy Way!
Shine thru the cloud and rain, Thru sorrow, toil and pain;
Make Thou my pathway plain- Teach me Thy Way!

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Long as my life shall last, Teach me Thy Way!
Where’er my lot be cast, Teach me Thy Way!
Until the race is run,Until the Journey’s done,
Until the crown is won, Teach me Thy Way!

file: The Church_s One Foundation (Samuel John Stone).xml
title: The Church's One Foundation

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
The church's one foundation
Is Jesus Christ, her Lord;
She is His new creation
By water and the word;
From heaven He came and sought her
To be His holy bride,
With His own blood He bought her,
And for her life He died.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Elect from every nation,
Yet one o’er all the earth,
Her charter of salvation—
One Lord, one faith, one birth;
One holy name she blesses,
Partakes one holy food,
And to one hope she presses
With every grace endued.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Though with a scornful wonder
Men see her sore oppressed,
By schisms rent asunder,
By heresies distressed,
Yet saints their watch are keeping,
Their cry goes up, ‘How long?’
And soon the night of weeping
Shall be the morn of song.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
’Mid toil, and tribulation,
And tumult of her war,
She waits the consummation
Of peace forever more;
Till with the vision glorious
Her longing eyes are blessed,
And the great church victorious
Shall be the church at rest.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
Yet she on earth hath union
With God the Three in One,
And mystic sweet communion
With those whose rest is won:
O happy ones and holy!
Lord, give us grace that we,
Like them, the meek and lowly,
On high may dwell with Thee.

file: The Day Thou Gavest Lord (John Ellerton).xml
title: The Day Thou Gavest Lord

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
The day Thou gavest, Lord, is ended,
The darkness falls at Thy behest;
To Thee our morning hymns ascended,
Thy praise shall sanctify our rest.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
We thank Thee that Thy church unsleeping,
While earth rolls onward into light,
Through all the world her watch is keeping,
And rests not now by day or night.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
As o’er each continent and island
The dawn leads on another day,
The voice of prayer is never silent,
Nor dies the strain of praise away.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
The sun that bids us rest is waking
Our brethren ’neath the western sky,
And hour by hour fresh lips are making
Thy wondrous doings heard on high.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
So be it, Lord! Thy throne shall never,
Like earth’s proud empires, pass away;
Thy kingdom stands, and grows for ever,
Till all Thy creatures own Thy sway.

file: The First Nowell (Author Unknown).xml
title: The First Nowell

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
The first nowell the angel did say
Was to certain poor shepherds in fields as they lay;
In fields where they lay keeping their sheep,
On a cold winter’s night that was so deep.

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
Nowell, nowell, nowell, nowell,
Born is the King of Israel!

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
They looked up and saw a star
Shining in the east, beyond them far,
And to the earth it gave great light,
And so it continued both day and night.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
And by the light of that same star
Three wise men came from country far;
To seek for a King was their intent,
And to follow the star wherever it went.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
This star drew nigh to the north-west;
Over Bethlehem it took its rest,
And there it did both stop and stay
Right over the place where Jesus lay.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
Then entered in those wise men three
Full reverently upon their knee,
And offered there in His presence
Their gold, and myrrh, and frankincense.

verses.name: v6
verses.text:
Then let us all with one accord
Sing praises to our heavenly Lord,
That hath made heaven and earth of nought,
And with His blood mankind hath bought.

file: The God of Abraham Praise (Thomas Olivers).xml
title: The God of Abraham Praise

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
The God of Abraham praise,
Who reigns enthroned above,
Ancient of everlasting days, and God of love.
Jehovah! Great I AM!
By earth and heaven confessed;
I bow and bless the sacred name forever blessed.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
The God of Abraham praise,
At whose supreme command
From earth I rise, and seek the joys at His right hand.
I all on earth forsake --
Its wisdom, fame, and power --
And Him my only portion make, my shield and tower.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
The God of Abraham praise,
Whose all-sufficient grace
Shall guide me all my happy days in all my ways.
He calls a worm His friend,
He calls Himself my God;
And He shall save me to the end through Jesu’s blood.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
He by Himself hath sworn,
I on His oath depend:
I shall, on eagles’ wings upborne, to heaven ascend;
I shall behold His face,
I shall His power adore,
And sing the wonders of His grace forever more.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
There dwells the Lord our King,
The Lord our Righteousness,
Triumphant o’er the world and sin, the Prince of Peace;
On Zion’s sacred height
His kingdom still maintains,
And glorious with His saints in light forever reigns.

verses.name: v6
v7
verses.text:
Before the Saviour’s face
The ransomed nations bow;
O’erwhelmed at His almighty grace, forever new:
He shows His prints of love,
They kindle to a flame,
And sound through all the worlds above the slaughtered Lamb.

verses.name: v8
verses.text:
The whole triumphant host
Give thanks to God on high;
Hail, Father, Son, and Holy Ghost! They ever cry.
Hail, Abraham’s God, and mine!
I join the heavenly lays;  All might and majesty 
are Thine, and endless praise.

file: The Head That Once Was Crowned (Thomas Kelly).xml
title: The Head That Once Was Crowned

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
The head that once was crowned
Is crowned with glory now;
A royal diadem adorns
The mighty Victor’s brow.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
The highest place that heaven affords
Is His by sovereign right,
The King of kings, the Lord of lords,
And heaven’s eternal light.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
The joy of all who dwell above,
The joy of all below,
To whom He manifests His love,
And grants His name to know.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
To them the cross, with all its shame,
With all its grace, is given;
Their name an everlasting name,
Their joy the joy of heaven.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
They suffer with their Lord below,
They reign with Him above;
Their profit and their joy to know
The mystery of His love.

verses.name: v6
verses.text:
The cross He bore is life and health,
Though shame and death to Him;
His people’s hope, His people’s wealth,
Their everlasting theme.

file: The King of Love (Henry W. Baker).xml
title: The King of Love

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
The King of Love my Shepherd is,
Whose goodness faileth never;
I nothing lack if I am His
And He is mine forever.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Where streams of living water flow
My ransomed soul He leadeth,
And where the verdant pastures grow
With food celestial feedeth.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Perverse and foolish oft I strayed,
But yet in love He sought me,
And on His shoulder gently laid,
And home rejoicing brought me.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
!n death’s dark vale I fear no ill
With Thee, dear Lord, beside me;
Thy rod and staff my comfort still,
Thy cross before to guide me.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
Thou spread’st a table in my sight;
Thy unction grace bestoweth:
And O what transport of delight
From Thy pure chalice floweth!

verses.name: v6
verses.text:
And so through all the length of days
Thy goodness faileth never;
Good Shepherd, may I sing Thy praise
Within Thy house forever.

file: The Lord Bless You (Peter lutkin).xml
title: The Lord Bless You

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
The Lord bless you and keep you
The Lord lift His countenance upon you
and give you peace
The Lord make his face shine upon you
And be gracious unto you
The Lord be gracious, gracious unto you. Amen

file: The Lord Has Given (Author Unknown).xml
title: The Lord Has Given

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
The Lord has given a land of good things,
I will press in and make them mine.
I’ll know His power, I’ll know His glory,
And in His kingdom I will shine.

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
With the high praises of God in our mouth
And a two-edged sword in our hand,
We’ll march right on to the victory side,
Right into Canaan’s land.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Gird up your armour, ye sons of Zion,
Gird up your armour, let’s go to war.
We’ll win the battle with great rejoicing,
And so we’ll praise Him more and more.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
We’ll bind their kings in chains and fetters,
We’ll bind their nobles tight in iron,
To execute God’s written judgement;
March on to glory, sons of Zion!

file: The Lord Your God is in Your Midst (Author Unknown).xml
title: The Lord Your God is in Your Midst

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
The Lord your God is in your midst,
The Lord of lords His name;
He will exult over you with joy,
He will renew you in His love,
He will rejoice over you
With shouts of joy, shouts of joy.
Shouts of joy, shouts of joy,
Shouts of joy.

file: The Lord_s my Shepherd (Author Unknown).xml
title: The Lord's my Shepherd

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
The Lord's my shepherd I’ll not want;
He makes me down to lie
In pastures green; He leadeth me
The quiet waters by.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
My soul He doth restore again;
And me to walk doth make
Within the paths of righteousness,
E’en for His own name’s sake.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Yea, though I walk in death’s dark vale,
Yet will I fear no ill;
For Thou art with me; and Thy rod
And staff me comfort still.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
My table Thou hast furnished
In presence of my foes;
My head Thou dost with oil anoint,
And my cup overflows.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
Goodness and mercy all my life
Shall surely follow me;
And in God’s house forever more
My dwelling place shall be.

file: The Virgin Had a Baby Boy (Author Unknown).xml
title: The Virgin Had a Baby Boy

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
The Virgin Mary had a baby boy,
The Virgin Mary had a baby boy,
The Virgin Mary had a baby boy,
And they said that His name was Jesus.

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
He come from the glory,
He come from the glorious kingdom.
He come from the glory,
He come from the glorious kingdom.
Oh, yes! believer.
Oh, yes! believer.
He come from the glory,
He come from the glorious kingdom.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
The angels sang when the baby was born,
The angels sang when the baby was born,
The angels sang when the baby was born,
And proclaiming Him the Saviour Jesus.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
The wise men saw where the baby was born,
The wise men saw where the baby was born,
The wise men saw where the baby was born,
And they saw that His name was Jesus.

file: There is a Green Hill Far Away (Cecil F. Alexander).xml
title: There is a Green Hill Far Away

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
There is a green hill far away,
Outside a city wall,
Where the dear Lord was crucified,
Who died to save us all.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
We may not know, we cannot tell,
What pains He had to bear;
But we believe it was for us
He hung and suffered there.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
He died that we might be forgiven,
He died to make us good,
That we might go at last to heaven,
Saved by His precious blood.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
There was no other good enough
To pay the price of sin;
He only could unlock the gate
Of heaven, and let us in.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
O dearly, dearly has He loved!
And we must love Him too,
And trust in His redeeming blood,
And try His works to do.

file: There is a Name I Love to Hear (Frederick Whitfield).xml
title: There is a Name I Love to Hear

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
There is a name I love to hear,
I love to speak its worth;
It sounds like music in my ear,
The sweetest name on earth.

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
O, how I love the Saviour’s name,
O, how I love the Saviour’s name,
O, how I love the Saviour’s name,
The sweetest name on earth.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
It tells me of a Saviour’s love,
Who died to set me free;
It tells me of His precious blood,
The sinner’s perfect plea.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
It tells of One whose loving heart
Can feel my deepest woe;
Who in my sorrow bears a part
That none can bear below.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
It bids my trembling heart rejoice,
It dries each rising tear;
It tells me in a still, small voice
To trust and never fear.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
Jesus, the name I love so well,
The name I love to hear!
No saint on earth its worth can tell,
No heart conceive how dear!

file: Thine be the Glory (Edmond Louis Budry).xml
title: Thine be the Glory

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Thine be the glory,
Risen, conquering Son;
Endless is the victory
Thou o’er death hast won.
Angels in bright raiment
Rolled the stone away,
Kept the folded grave-clothes
Where Thy body lay.

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
Thine be the glory,
Risen, conquering Son;
Endless is the victory
Thou o’er death hast won!

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Lo, Jesus meets us,
Risen from the tomb!
Lovingly He greets us,
Scatters fear and gloom.
Let the church with gladness
Hymns of triumph sing,
For her Lord now liveth,
Death hath lost its sting.

verses.name: v3

file: Thou Didst Leave Thy Throne (Emily E. Steele Elliott).xml
title: Thou Didst Leave Thy Throne

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Thou didst Leave Thy throne and Thy kingly crown,
When Thou camest to earth for me;
But in Bethlehem’s home there was found no room
For Thy holy nativity:
O come to my heart, Lord Jesus!
There is room in my heart for Thee.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Heaven’s arches rang when the angels sang,
Proclaiming Thy royal degree;
But of lowly birth cam’st Thou, Lord, on earth,
And in great humility,
O come to my heart, Lord Jesus!
There is room in my heart for Thee.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
The foxes found rest, and the birds had their nest,
In the shade of the cedar tree;
But Thy couch was the sod, O Thou Son of God,
In the deserts of Galilee.
O come to my heart, Lord Jesus!
There is room in my heart for Thee.
Thou camest, O Lord, with the living word
That should set Thy children free;
But with mocking scorn, and with crown of thorn,
They bore Thee to Calvary.
O come to my heart, Lord Jesus!
Thy cross is my only plea.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
When heaven’s arches shall ring, and her choirs shall sing,
At Thy coming to victory,
Let Thy voice call me home, saying, ‘Yet there is room,
There is room at My side for thee.’
And my heart shall rejoice, Lord Jesus,
When Thou comest and callest for me.

file: Thou Whose Almighty Word (John Marriott).xml
title: Thou Whose Almighty Word

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Thou, whose almighty word
Chaos and darkness heard,
And took their flight;
Hear us, we humbly pray,
And where the gospel-day
Sheds not its glorious ray,
Let there be light!

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Thou who didst come to bring,
On Thy redeeming wing,
Healing and sight;
Health to the sick in mind,
Sight to the inly blind,
O now to all mankind
Let there be light!

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Spirit of truth and love,
Life-giving, holy Dove,
Speed forth Thy flight;
Move on the waters’ face,
Bearing the lamp of grace,
And in earth’s darkest place
Let there be light!

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Blessed and holy Three,
Glorious Trinity,
Wisdom, love, might;
Boundless as ocean’s tide
Rolling in fullest pride,
Through the world far and wide
Let there be light!

file: Through all the changing scenes of life (N. Tate).xml
title: Through all the changing scenes of life

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Through all the changing scenes of life,
In trouble and in joy,
The praises of my God shall still
My heart and tongue employ.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Of His deliverance I will boast,
Till all that are distressed
From my example comfort take,
And charm their griefs to rest.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
O magnify the Lord with me,
With me exalt His name;
When in distress to Him I called,
He to my rescue came.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
The hosts of God encamp around
The dwellings of the just;
Deliverance He affords to all
Who on His succour trust.

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
O make but trial of His love;
Experience will decide
How blest are they, and only they,
Who in His truth confide.

verses.name: v6

file: Thy Hand O God Has Guided (Edward Hayes Plumptre).xml
title: Thy Hand O God Has Guided

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Thy Hand, O God has guided
Thy flock, from age to age;
The wondrous tale is written,
Full clear on every page.
Our fathers owned Thy goodness,
And we their deeds record;
And both of this bear witness:
One Church, one Faith, one Lord.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Thy heralds brought glad tidings
To greatest as to least;
They bade them rise and hasten
To share the great King’s feast.
And this was all their teaching
In every deed and word;
To all alike proclaiming:
One Church, one Faith, one Lord.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Through many a day of darkness,
Through many a scene of strife,
The faithful few fought bravely
To guard the nation’s life.
Their gospel of redemption,
Sin pardoned, man restored,
Was all in this enfolded:
One Church, one Faith, one Lord.

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Thy mercy will not fail us,
Nor leave Thy work undone;
With Thy right hand to help us,
The victory shall be won.
And then, by men and angels,
Thy name shall be adored,
And this shall be their anthem:
One Church, one Faith, one Lord.

file: Tunay Kang Matapat (Tagalog Hymn).xml
title: Tunay Kang Matapat

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Tunay Kang matapat, Dios nami't Ama, 
Di nagbabago, di nag-iiba;
Mahapon, matanghali, maumaga,
Sa buong panahon, matapat Ka.

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
Tunay Kang matapat,
Araw-araw aking namamalas
Ang Iyong kabutihang walang kupas;
Tunay Kang matapat, sa paglingap!

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Tag-araw, tag-ulan at ang tag-ani,
Araw, buwa't bituin sa gabi,
Nag-aawitang lagi't sumasaksi
Sa katapatan Mong anong laki!

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Kapatawaran at kapayapaan,
Mga pangako Mong umaakbay,
Lakas ngayo'y pag-asang sumisilang
Ang lahat ng ito'y Iyong bigay!

file: Tunay na Kaybuti ng Mananakop (Tagalog Hymn).xml
title: Tunay na Kaybuti ng Mananakop

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Tunay na kaybuti ng Mananakop
Si Kristo kong Manunubos;
Ang buhay ko'y laging iniingatan,
Dulot N'ya ay kagalakan

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
Kaluluwa ko'y laging iniingatan
Ni Kristong aking kanlungan;
Di nagmamaliw ang Kanyang pag-ibig
Ako'y ligtas sa panganib
Ako'y ligtas sa panganib

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
O tunay na kaybuti na kaybuti Nya sa akin
Inaalis ang pasanin
S'ya ay kaakbay ko sa bawat hakbang
At tangi kong kalakasan

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Saganang biyaya sa araw-araw
Kay Kristo ay nakakamtan;
Ang aking puso'y lagi nang may awit
Pag-ibig nya'y pinupuri

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
At pag sa langit atin S'yang namasdan
Kabanala'y ating taglay
Ang kanyang pag-ibig at kaligtasan
Aawitin kaylanpaman

file: Turuang Manalangin (Tagalog Hymn).xml
title: Turuang Manalangin

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Turuan Mong Manalangin
Ng buong Pagsamba
Abab man sa 'Yong paningin
Dapat lapitan Ka

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Kami ay mapapahamak
Kung 'di manalangin
Habang sa'Yo'y papalapit
Nawa'y salubungin

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
Bigyang kababaang-loob
At ng pagsisisi
Isang hangaring marubdob
Tinig Mo'y marinig

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Pananampalataya lang
Sa sala'y magligtas
Pananalig nakatuon
Sa'king Manunubos

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
Kat'yagaang manalangi't
Sa'Yo ay maghintay
Pagtitiwalang matibay
Ako ma'y mamatay

verses.name: v6
verses.text:
Itong lahat Igawad Mo't
Kalooba'y gawin
Sa tulong ng Espiritu'y
Kayang manalangin

file: We Plough the Fields (Matthias Claudius).xml
title: We Plough the Fields

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
We plough the fields and scatter
The good seed on the land,
But it is fed and watered
By God’s almighty hand;
He sends the snow in winter,
The warmth to swell the grain,
The breezes and the sunshine,
And soft refreshing rain.

verses.name: c1
verses.text:
All good gifts around us
Are sent from heaven above;
Then thank the Lord, O thank the Lord,
For all His love.

verses.name: v2
v3
verses.text:
We thank Thee, then, O Father,
For all things bright and good;
The seedtime and the harvest,
Our life, our health, our food.
No gifts have we to offer
For all Thy love imparts,
But that which Thou desirest,
Our humble, thankful hearts.

file: We Rest on Thee (Edith G. Cherry).xml
title: We Rest on Thee

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
We rest on Thee, our Shield and our Defender!
We go not forth alone against the foe;
Strong in Thy strength, safe in Thy keeping tender,
We rest on Thee and in Thy name we go.
Strong in Thy strength, safe in Thy keeping tender,
We rest on Thee, and in Thy name we go.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Yes, in Thy name, O Captain of salvation!
In Thy dear name, all other names above,
Jesus our Righteousness, our sure Foundation,
Our Prince of glory and our King of love.
Jesus our Righteousness, our sure Foundation,
Our Prince of glory and our King of love.

verses.name: v3
v4
verses.text:
We rest on Thee, our Shield and our Defender!
Thine is the battle, Thine shall be the praise;
When passing through the gates of pearly splendour,
Victors, we rest with Thee, through endless days.
When passing through the gates of pearly splendour,
Victors, we rest with Thee, through endless days.

file: Were You There_ (Author Unknown).xml
title: Were You There?

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
Where you there when they crucified my Lord?
Were you there when they crucified my Lord?
Oh, sometimes it causes me to tremble, tremble, tremble.
Were you there when they crucified my Lord?

verses.name: v2
verses.text:

Were you there when they nailed Him to the tree?
Oh, sometimes it causes me to tremble, tremble, tremble. 
Were you there when they nailed Him to the tree?

verses.name: v3
verses.text:

Were you there when they laid Him in the tomb? 
Oh, sometimes it causes me to tremble, tremble, tremble.

file: What Child is This (William Chatterton Dix).xml
title: What Child is This

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
What child is this, who, laid to rest
On Mary’s lap is sleeping:
Whom angels greet with anthems sweet,
While shepherds watch are keeping?
This, this is Christ the King,
Whom shepherds guard and angels sing:
Haste, haste, to bring Him praise,
The babe, the Son of Mary.

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Why lies He in such mean estate,
Where ox and ass are feeding?
Good Christians, fear, for sinners here
The silent Word is pleading.
Nails, spear shall pierce Him through,
The cross be borne for me, for you.
Hail, hail the Word made flesh,
The babe, the Son of Mary.

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
So bring Him incense, gold and myrrh,
Come, peasant, king, to own Him;
The King of kings salvation brings,
Let loving hearts enthrone Him.
Raise, raise a song on high,
The virgin sings her lullaby.
Joy, joy for Christ is born,
The babe, the Son of Mary.

file: When Morning Gilds the Skies (Edward Caswall).xml
title: When Morning Gilds the Skies

verses.name: v1
verses.text:
When morning gilds the skies
My heart awaking cries:
‘May Jesus Christ be praised!’
Alike at work and prayer
To Jesus I repair:
‘May Jesus Christ be praised!’

verses.name: v2
verses.text:
Does sadness fill my mind?
A solace here I find:
‘May Jesus Christ be praised!’
When evil thoughts molest,
With this I shield my breast:
‘May Jesus Christ be praised!’

verses.name: v3
verses.text:
To God, the Word, on high
The hosts of angels cry:
‘May Jesus Christ be praised!’
Let mortals, too, upraise
Their voice in hymns of praise:
‘May Jesus Christ be praised!’

verses.name: v4
verses.text:
Let earth’s wide circle round
In joyful notes resound:
‘May Jesus Christ be praised!’
Let air, and sea, and sky,
From depth to height, reply:
‘May Jesus Christ be praised!’

verses.name: v5
verses.text:
Be this while life is mine
My canticle divine:
‘May Jesus Christ be praised!’
Be this the eternal song,
Through all the ages long:
‘May Jesus Christ be praised!’

I will sing as David sang.
